education_auth_login.learn: Ukungena kuya kukuphinda ukuxhumana nerekhodi osevele uyenzile. Akunikezi lalo lunye ilungelo futhi akususi nakuliphi. Amalungelo akho ahambisana nalapho uhlala khona, hhayi nale seshini.
education_auth_login.s1_detail: I-akhawunti yakho ngeyakho wedwa. Iserba sivumela izizama ezinhlanu ngomzuzu, bese siyisa phansi izizama ezintsha isikhathi esifushane futhi sisho njalo enkundleni ye-imeyili.
education_auth_login.s2_detail: Ubuyela lapho ubeniya khona, noma ekhaya lakho lemisebenzi yomphakathi. Ukungena akushintshi lutho ongakwenza.
education_auth_login.s3_detail: Kule beta, ukuhlala kuqinisekiswa ngomzuzu ozimemela ngayo. Ukuvota nokufuna isihlalo kuqala khona manje. Alikho isinyathelo sesibili futhi akukho muntu okukuvuma.
education_auth_login.s3_do: Qinisekisa lapho uhlala khona, uma ungakayenzi
education_auth_login.why: i-app ithola ilungelo lokuvota ekuhlala ngokwayo, ngesikhathi esifanayo neqiniso lokuhlala endaweni ethile, ngakho akukho okungaba phakathi kwakubo kobabili. Iseshini iyikhiye kuphelalerekhodi lakho. Ayisoze yaba yisisekelo selungelo.
education_auth_operator_login.learn: Lokhu kungena kulawula i-instance. Akusona isindlela sokungena kuhulumeni. Isimo somsebenzi (operator) siyisisekelo futhi asinalo ivoti, isihlalo, noma isikhundla kunoma iyiphi indawo yegunya.
education_auth_operator_login.s1_detail: Lokhu kungena kuhlukile kwi-akhawunti yakho yomuzi. Iserba sivumela izizama ezinhlanu ngomzuzu, bese siyisa phansi izizama ezintsha isikhathi esifushane futhi sisho njalo enkundleni yegama lomsebenzi.
education_auth_operator_login.s1_do: Faka igama lakho lomsebenzi nephasiwedi yakho
education_auth_operator_login.s2_detail: Ufika ekonsoleni yomsebenzi: izinsizakalo zokuhost-a, ama-mesh peers, nezilungiselelo. Awutholi amandla obuholi ngokungena lapha.
education_auth_operator_login.s3_detail: Ukuvota, ukufuna isihlalo, nokufaka amafomu omphakathi konke kuyingxenye yerekhodi lakho lomuzi, hhayi kuleli lungena.
education_auth_operator_login.s3_do: Sebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho yomuzi kunoma yini ephathelene nomphakathi
education_auth_operator_login.why: umthethosisekelo uxhumela igunya endaweni yegunya nasebantwini abakuyawo, hhayi kunoma ubani olawula izerba. Ukugcina lokhu kungena kuhlukile kugcina lowo mugqa ucacile: ukuphatha isoftware akusona isihlalo kuhulumeni.
education_auth_register.learn: Ukwakha i-akhawunti kukunika indawo yokuma — akukho okungaphezulu kwalokho nokungaphansi kwalokho. Akukwenzi ube umhlali, futhi ayisoze yanqume ukuthi ungavota yini.
education_auth_register.s1_detail: I-akhawunti yakho ngeyakho wedwa. Ungasebenzisa igama okungekho muntu ongakuxhumanisa nawe — i-app yakhelwe amagama angeyona eqiniso.
education_auth_register.s2_detail: Manje usungu R-01 (Umuntu). Ungabuka konke okungumphakathi futhi ufake amafomu ambalwa mayelana nawe.
education_auth_register.s3_detail: Kukhethwa ngokuzithandela, futhi kungashintshwa noma nini. Akukho ukhetho lwephrofayili okuvula noma okuvimba ilungelo.
education_auth_register.why: amalungelo lapha ayingxenye yakho — i-app ayiwanawo, kodwa iwaqaphela nje lapho uhlala endaweni ethile. Ukubhalisa kuwukugcina amarekhodi, hhayi imvume.
education_build_progress.learn: Le khasi likhombisa umhlaba osungulwa: izindawo ezivuka, izifunda ezidwetshwa, izindawo zombuso ezihlala izihlalo. Isifasitelu somshini, futhi akukho okukho lapha okucela lutho kuwe.
education_build_progress.s1_detail: Isinyathelo ngasinye siyisigaba zonke izindawo ezidlula kuzo: imingcele ilayidiwe, abantu abanele, izifunda zidwetshwe, isigaba sesihlalo sihlala.
education_build_progress.s2_detail: Khetha indawo ubuke umugqa wayo uhamba. Lapho isishayamthetho sayo sisebenza, ikhasi lendawo liyakhombisa isigaba.
education_build_progress.s3_detail: Ukwakhiwa kulandela isikhathi futhi kungaqhubeka. Uma kumele, kuqhubeka lapho kwamise khona; akukho sisebenzi esikuqala kabusha ngesandla.
education_build_progress.why: izinhulumeni lapha zisungulwa ngomthetho, hhayi ngomyalo. Ukubuka umthetho usebenza yindlela yokwazi ukuthi akukho muntu okhethe ukuthi ubani ozothola isishayamthetho.
education_civic_commons_halls.learn: Ingxoxo eqondile ehambisana nemisebenzi kahulumeni — futhi ungaguqula okushiwo lapha kube ubufakazi obovalawe.
education_civic_commons_halls.s1_detail: Ukubopha okufanayo emthethosivivinywa, izinhlolovo namakomiti njengemaholo anezihloko.
education_civic_commons_halls.s2_detail: Umshwana okhulunywayo noma obhalwayo uba yingxenye yerekhodi elingaguquki lapho uli-fayila.
education_civic_commons_halls.why: akukho okusekhoneni lerekhodi kuze kube yilapho othile ekufaka khona ngokuzimela. Inkulumo eqondile inkulumo nje; ubufakazi kuwufayila.
education_civic_commons_square.learn: Inguqulo eqondile yesikhala, ethunyelwa nge-mesh ukuze abantu bezerba ezahlukene babelane ngegumbi elilodwa.
education_civic_commons_square.s1_detail: Ingxoxo nezwi ngesikhathi sangempela, ngokuphashane nesikhala esinezihloko.
education_civic_commons_square.s2_detail: Igumbi eliphilayo lingabasebenzi bokuhlala kuphela; isikweya esinezingxoxo sivulekile kuwo wonke umuntu ongena. Isisekelo sifana, kodwa amagumbi ahlukile.
education_civic_commons_square.why: irekhodi eliphala nengxoxo ephilayo izinto ezahlukene nezimithetho ehlukile. Irekhodi alikwazi ukususa okuthile futhi livulekile; igumbi eliphilayo yindawo abayibambe omakhelwane bakho.
education_civic_halls.learn: Lapho ingxoxo ihambisana nemisebenzi yanguqumbe yombuso — umthethosivivinywa, inhlolovo, isicelo, ikomiti — nalapho ungabeka ubufakazi ngendlela ephala irekhodini.
education_civic_halls.s1_detail: Amahholo azibophele ezintweni zangempela zobuholi, ngakho ingxoxo ihlala isinqumweni.
education_civic_halls.s3_detail: Lena yisinyathelo esihlukile: ukuphala kubeka amazwi akho irekhodi lomphakathi eliphala, futhi kudinga ukuhlala kule ndawo yegunya.
education_civic_halls.why: ukukhuluma kuvulekile kuwo wonke umuntu; ukufakaza kuhulumeni kuyisenzo somuntu lo hulumeni ophendulayo. Lapho kuphela ukuhlala kubalulekile lapha — futhi kumayelana nirekhodi, hhayi ngokuthi ubani ongakhuluma.
education_civic_home.learn: Ikhasi lakho lokuqala lwendawo: okwenzekayo lapho uhlala khona, nokuthi yini ongayenza manje.
education_civic_home.s1_detail: Ungezinye zezindawo zegunya ezikuzungezile — kusukela emakhelwane kuya emhlabeni wonke — futhi ngayinye ingaba nemisebenzi yayo.
education_civic_home.s2_detail: Amaphepha okuvota, izicelo, nemihlangano ongayijoyina avele lapha. Noma yini ongakakwazi ukuyenza ibonisa ngokucacile ukuthi kungani.
education_civic_home.s3_detail: Kukutshela ukuthi ukuhlala kuqinisekisiwe yini. Uma kuqinisekisiwe, ungavota futhi umele isihlalo — ayikho eminye imfuneko.
education_civic_home.why: umuntu oyedwa ungumhlali wezindawo eziningi ezihambelanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi ngayinye yalezo zindawo izibusa yona. Lolu skrini luwukuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke.
education_civic_identity_verification.le: Kukhethweka. Kukhona ezimweni ezidinga ubuqotho bokuzazi — futhi akukaze kube imfuneko yokuvota noma ukumela isihlalo.
education_civic_identity_verification.s1: Alukho lutho kulolu skrini oludingekayo ukuze uhlanganyele ekubuseni.
Thumela ukuqinisekisa kuphela uma ukufuna noma ukudinga
education_civic_identity_verification.s2: Akusheshisi ukuhlala, akuniki indima, futhi akuvuli ilungelo obungalenalo kakade.
education_civic_identity_verification.wh: isihlola sohlelo lunohlu oluqinile lwento engake ibophelele efomeni yamalungelo — kuhlanganise ne-requires_identity_verification. Isifayila esizama ukwenza ukuzazi kube yisimo sokuvota sizalawe yinjini, hhayi nje ukugqugquzelwa.
education_civic_journey.s1_detail: Isinyathelo ngasinye sisho ifomu noma inqubo yangempela ngemuva kwaso, ukuze ukwazi ukuya uyithole.
education_civic_journey.s3_detail: Impumelelo ihlala irekhodini lakho futhi iqine. Impumelelo ayishintshi neze ivoti, isihlalo, noma lokho ovumeleke ukukwenza.
education_civic_journeys.learn: Imihlahlandlela eqondisayo yokuthi umhlaba usebenza kanjani ngempela — ukhetho kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, umthethosivivinywa uphehlelwa ube umthetho, icala lenkantolo kusukela ekufayileni kuze kube esimeni sokugcina.
education_civic_journeys.s1_detail: Iyinye yezinqubo zangempela kulolu hlelo, ihlukaniswe ezinyathelweni zayo zangempela.
education_civic_journeys.s2_detail: Lolu uhambo ozuhla wena, hhayi irekhodi yalokho okwenzile. Zilapha ukuze zichaze, hhayi ukuze ziqinisekise.
education_civic_journeys.s3_detail: Ukuqedela uhambo kubhala impumelelo. Akuniki lutho — hhayi ivoti, hhayi isihlalo, hhayi ikhono.
education_civic_journeys.why: i-app inezinhlelo eziningi. Izinhambo ziyimephu. Bakunika lutho ngabomu, ukuze ukufunda indlela ungakwazi ukuba yisidingo sokuhlanganyela.
education_civic_live_room.learn: Yonke imihlangano kulo mhlaba — ikomiti, igumbi lezishayamthetho, itafula likesigungu esiphethe, inkantolo, ibhodi, iforum, ihholo lomphakathi, noma iqembu labangane — ligumbi elilodwa ongangena kulo. Emizimbeni yomphakathi igumbi lokubuka livulekile njalo, noma ungumhlali noma cha; amaqembu azizenzela imithetho yawo yokungena.
education_civic_live_room.s1_detail: Izikhathi, amakomiti, izinkantolo, nezinhlogo zomphakathi zivulekile ukuze zibukwe y noma ubani — awulazimeli ukuhlala ukuze nje ubone umsebenzi kahulumeni. Izinhlangano namagumbi amaqembu azinquma ukubonakala kwawo; lelo khululeko lingalabo.
education_civic_live_room.s2_detail: Emzimbeni obuswa, izindawo zokuqala ezimbili zishiyelele ngokomthethosisekelo — amandla esimo esiphuthumayo kuqala, izindaba zomthethosisekelo zesibili — bese usihlalo uhlela okusele. Iqembu labangane alina lokhu; imithetho yawo yokuhleleka iyasebenza.
education_civic_live_room.s3_detail: Abahlali baphakamisa isandla ukuze bakhulume; usihlalo uqaphela abakhulumayo futhi ulawula isikhathi. Ingxoxo ihamba ngegama lakho eliyisibonelo, hhayi igama lomthetho — futhi emihlalweni ungufayila umlayezo wakho njengobufakazi, oklanywe ukuba ube yirekhodi lomphakathi ephala.
education_civic_live_room.s4_detail: Lapho usihlalo ebiza umbuzo, zombili izinhlangano zibala zonke izihlalo ezisebenzayo — ikhoramu yiningi yaBONKE abasebenzayo, ngakho ilungu elingekho libalwa njenge-cha futhi iningi alinciphi lapho abantu behlala ekhaya. Ikhasi alizenzeli izibalo zalo; izinombolo zivela emshinini yokubala.
education_civic_live_room.why: Leli gumbi alikwazi ukucenshwa. Alikho isisebenzi, isishayamthetho, noma ijaji elingasusa isithamo ngenxa yombono waso — ukususa okukhona kuphela kungama-four (umyalo wenkantolo, ukuvikela amalungelo omunye, ukuvimba kwakho, anti-spam), futhi ukususa konke kuyirekhodi lomphakathi.
education_civic_my_record.learn: Konke i-app ekugcinile ngawe, endaweni eyodwa — okungumphakathi, okuyimfihlo, nokungakushintsha.
education_civic_my_record.s1_detail: Izenzo zakho njengomphathi noma umkhethwa zingumphakathi ngokwakhiwa komthethosisekelo. Impilo yakho ejwayelekile lapha ayikho kanjalo.
education_civic_my_record.s2_detail: Iphrofayili yakho iziphatha wena. Awufayili isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yakho.
education_civic_my_record.s3_detail: Baqopha lokho okukwenze. Impumelelo ayishintshi kuvoti, isihlalo, noma lokho ovumeleke ukukwenza — futhi ziyimfihlo ngaphandle kokuba ukhethe ukuzikhombisa.
education_civic_my_record.why: umugqa udwebwa emandleni. Uma uphethe amandla irekhodi lingumphakathi, unomphela. Phila impilo yakho futhi iyeyakho.
education_civic_petition_detail.learn: Isicelo esisodwa, umbhalo waso, izigxiviso zaso, nokuthi siphi kanye isimo saso.
education_civic_petition_detail.s1_detai: Lokho okusayina yikona okuya phambili — amazwi awushintshi ngaphansi kwakho.
education_civic_petition_detail.s2_detai: Ungashintsha umqondo — kuze kube isikhathi lapho ukubalwa okucwaningwayo kuqala.
education_civic_petition_detail.s2_do: Sayina, noma ususe isigxiviso osuvele wasinika
education_civic_petition_detail.s3_detai: Ibhodi lokukhetho licwaninga izigxiviso; inkantolo ingabuyekeza ukuhambisana komthethosisekelo kwesicelo ngaphambi kokuba kuqhubeke.
education_civic_petition_detail.why: isigxiviso singasusa ngoba imvume engakwazi ukususa ayiyona imvume. Ayisusa ekucwaningweni, ngoba ukubala kufanele kube ukubala.
education_civic_petitions.learn: Indlela abantu abenza ngayo umthetho ngaphandle kokulinda isishayamthetho sivumelane.
education_civic_petitions.s1_detail: Noma ubani ohlobene nendawo yegunya angasayina.
education_civic_petitions.s1_do: Funda izicelo ezivulekile lapho uhlala khona
education_civic_petitions.s3_detail: Ubhala umbhalo. Uma sifika emkhawulweni wezigxiviso, isishayamthetho kufanele sisithathe.
education_civic_petitions.why: Art. II §6 yindlela yokubaleka zisishayamthetho esingasoze sisebenze. Umkhawulo uyiphesenti yezakhamuti zendawo yegunya, ngakho indawo encane idinga izigxiviso ezimbalwa kanti enkulu idinga eziningi — umkhawulo uhambisana nalabo okumele bakhuthazwe.
education_civic_public_square.learn: Iforum lomphakathi elivulekile lendawo yakho yegunya. Alikwazi ukucenshwa — futhi lo wumthetho womthethosisekelo, hhayi inqubo abayikhethile abasebenzi.
education_civic_public_square.s1_detail: Noma ubani ongena angapostha lapha — noma ungumhlali noma cha. Isikwele sivulekile; ukuhlala kuvimba amandla, hhayi inkulumo.
education_civic_public_square.s2_detail: Ukuvimba kuwisenzo sakho somfihlo. Kushintsha okubona kwakho hhayi kwomunye.
education_civic_public_square.s3_detail: Isithamo singasuswa kuphela ngezincwadi zegunya lenkantolo, ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo omunye, ngokuzivimba kwakho, noma ngokuvalwa kokukhangisa okungakhethi ngokuqukumbela. Ukususa konke kubhalwa irekhodi kanye nesizathu sako.
education_civic_public_square.why: akukho "okuphambana nemigomo yethu" lapha, futhi akukho ophathi noma isishayamthetho esingayengeza lokho. Uhlolo lokususa lwamukela izizathu ezimbili kuphela futhi lufuna ubufakazi ngasinye — ukususa nganoma yiziphi ezinye izizathu kunqandwa uhlelo.
education_civic_relocation.learn: Kwenzekani empilweni yakho yezomphakathi lapho usutshintshelwe.
education_civic_relocation.s1_detail: Awufayili isicelo sokudlulisela. Ukuhlanganyela kulandela lapho ukhona empeleni.
education_civic_relocation.s2_detail: Ukuhlala okuhlala endaweni entsha kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhona lapho, kanti ukuhlanganyela kwakudala kuphela ngokwakho.
education_civic_relocation.s3_detail: Umlando wakho uhlala nawe. Okushintshayo ukuthi uvotela kuphi, hhayi ukuthi ungubani.
education_civic_relocation.why: ilungelo lokuvota lilandela umuntu, ngokuzenzakalela. Akekho ongakushiya phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili, futhi akekho okumele aqophe ukuthutha kwakho.
education_civic_residency.learn: Lesi isikrini esibaluleke kakhulu. Ukuqinisekisa lapho uhlala khona yinto eyodwa ephakathi kwakho nelungelo lokuvota nokugijima ezikhundleni.
education_civic_residency.s1_detail: Ubala indawo. Akekho oyivumelayo — awicelanga imvume.
education_civic_residency.s2_detail: Idivayisi yakho ihlola ngokuthulela ngemuva. Ama-ping afakazela ukuba khona kwakho; ayimfihlo futhi awashayelwa phansi.
education_civic_residency.s2_do: Vumela uhlelo ukuba luqinisekise ukuthi ukhona lapho ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
education_civic_residency.s3_detail: Uhlelo lufayila ukuqinisekisa ngokwalo lapho usuhlele lapho isikhathi esanele. Awudingi ukucela, futhi akukho sisebenzi sikahulumeni esisayina.
education_civic_residency.s4_detail: Ngesikhathi ukuhlala kuqinisekiswa uba Ngumhlali, futhi i-Voter ikhiphelwa ngaleso sikhathi. Akukho kuvunyelwa okuhlukile, akukho uhlu lokulinda, akukho uhlolvo.
education_civic_residency.s4_do: Amalungelo akho ayavulwa — wonke, ngasikhathi sinye
education_civic_residency.why: Art. I uthi ungavota "kungakhathaliseki nayiphi isici ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwendawo yegunya." Ikhodi ikuthatha njengoba kunjalo — u-Voter (R-04) uthathwa ngokufana ne-Associated (R-03), ngakho akukho okungafakwa phakathi kokuhlala endaweni nokuvotela lapho.
education_civic_rooms.learn: Imilayezo yakho eqondile neyeqembu ikhuluma lapha — izingxoxo ezimfihlo zokukhuluma, amafayela, izwi, nevidiyo. Lena yingxenye eyimfihlo yempilo yakho yezomphakathi: abantu abasengxoxweni kuphela abangayifunda.
education_civic_rooms.s1_detail: Ingxoxo ivikelwe ubulungu nokunye kuphela — akukho sikhundla, akukho indima, nokuhlala akavumeli omunye ukuba angene. Uma ungakuyo, awiziboni, futhi akukho uhlu lwamamali ongawubheka.
education_civic_rooms.s2_detail: Umuntu oyedwa wenza umlayezo oqondile; abambalwa benza umlayezo weqembu. Noma ngabe kunjani, abantu nje abakhulumayo — akukho okufayilwe, futhi akukho okungena irekhodi lomphakathi.
education_civic_rooms.s3_detail: Umbhalo, amafayela, izwi, nevidiyo bahlanganyela ithuluzi elilodwa, elifana kubantu ababili noma ishumi. Iqembu eliphilayo lingavula igumbi lezwi nevidiyo ngokuthinta kanye.
education_civic_rooms.s4_detail: Isithamo esikhoneni somphakathi sisekhoneni futhi sivulelekile kunoma ubani ongene. Umlayezo lapha uyimfihlo njengephepha lokuvota. Isigaba esifanayo esigcina isikhona sivulekile sigcina this room ivaleleke.
education_dev_electoral_kit.learn: Ithuluzi lokuthuthukisa. Akukhona i-UI yomkhiqizo — ikhishwe ekhasini lemfundo.
education_dev_executive_kit.learn: Ithuluzi lokuthuthukisa. Akukhona i-UI yomkhiqizo — ikhishwe ekhasini lemfundo.
education_dev_judiciary_kit.learn: Ithuluzi lokuthuthukisa. Akukhona i-UI yomkhiqizo — ikhishwe ekhasini lemfundo.
education_dev_legislature_kit.learn: Ithuluzi lokuthuthukisa lokuhlola izici ngokwakhe. Akukhona i-UI yomkhiqizo — akuyona ingxenye yempilo yezomphakathi yanoma ubani futhi ayinalo okuqukethwe kwemfundo.
education_economy_agreement_detail.learn: Isivumelwano esisodwa, ngokugcwele: abahlanganyela baso, imigomo yaso, lapho simi khona. Uyasifunda ngoba ubhalwe kuso — akekho omunye ongakwenza lokho.
education_economy_agreement_detail.s1_de: Umlingiswa ngamunye uvela endaweni yakhe, obonakaliwe irekhodi eqinisekisiwe yokuhlala — hhayi nge-akhawunti ekhokhelwe noma isigaba sokuvumeleka. Imigomo iyimfihlo kubantu ababalwe lapha.
education_economy_agreement_detail.s2_de: Isinqumo sakho sibhalwa ngokwakho ubunjalo kuphela. Ukusayina kukubopha lapho wonke umuntu esusayine; ukwenqaba kusho ukuthi isivumelwano asikho nhlobo. Ukungabikho kwesigayina esisodwa kusho ukungabikho kwesivumelwano.
education_economy_agreement_detail.s3_de: Akukho sikhiye lapha esingasusa ilungelo — isikhiye esiphambile asisebenzi kanti esinye siyahlala — futhi imigomo yomsebenzi ayikwazi ukususa ilungelo labasebenzi lokumela ibhodi.
education_economy_agreement_detail.s4_de: Uma wonke amaphathi esayine, isivumelwano singena osebenzi oyedwa kubala kwabasebenzi benhlangano. Lokhu kubala — okubalwa ezivumelwanweni, hhayi okumemezwa ngabanikazi — yilokho okwenza abasebenzi bathole isihlalo sabo sokuqala sebhodi ku-100 nezihlalo ezilinganayo ku-2,000.
education_economy_agreement_detail.s4_do: Uma kuyumsebenzi ophindaphindayo, yazi ukuthi ukusayina kuqalisa ini
education_economy_agreements.learn: Noma yikuphi amaphathi amabili noma ngaphezulu angabeka imigomo ngokukhululeka phakathi kwabo — lokho inkululeko yokwenza isivumelwano. Kodwa zonke izivumelwano zisezingeni elithile: akukho isigaba esingakhwebula, singathengisa, noma singasayina isikhondo somthethosisekelo, futhi akukho okubopha kuze kube yilapho wonke amaphathi esayine.
education_economy_agreements.s1_detail: Umsebenzi ophindaphindayo, ukudluliselwa kokuba ngumnikazi, ukuthengisa, i-akhawunti eyabelwana ngayo, noma noma yini eyenziwe ngokukhethekile — uhlobo lwakho lufayila njengirekhodi lalo. Isivumelwano somsebenzi ophindaphindayo siphinde sikubhalise njengosebenzi waleyo nhlangano.
education_economy_agreements.s2_detail: Isivumelwano esingakwesayina uhlangothi olulodwa asikaze sisebenze. Kuze kube yilapho wonke amaphathi abalulwe esayine, isivumelwano asikho futhi asibopi muntu — akukho isimo sokwesekela noma sokulindela.
education_economy_agreements.s3_detail: Isigaba esithinta ukuvota, ukuba umkhethwa, ukuhlala, ukwenza isicelo, noma inqubo efanele asisebenzi — okunye kwesivumelwano kusasebenza. Futhi akukho sivumelwano esingabeka intengo ekusebenziseni isikhondo somphakathi.
education_economy_agreements.s4_detail: Imigomo yesivumelwano ifundeka kuphela amaphathi aso, njengephepha lokuvota. Okuba ngomphakathi yilokho kuphela okudalwa isivumelwano — ukubalwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhamba phakathi kwezakhawunti — hhayi imigomo uqobo lwayo.
education_economy_agreements.why: Ukuthi bobabili kumele basayine akusona isinqumo i-app eyihlola — yimthetho edluliswa ngedatha uqobo lwayo. Irekhodi ngeke libekwe njengelisebenzayo kuze kube yilapho isikhathi sokusayina kwawo wonke amaphathi abalulwe sikhona, ngakho akukho iphutha, umphathi, noma ikhodi engakwazi ukusebenzisa isivumelwano sohlangothi olulodwa.
education_economy_exchange.learn: Indawo yokuhwebelana ngamasheya enhlangano — irekhodi eliphilayo, incwadi yezicelo, nokuhwebelana kwamanje, konke kuvulekile. Izinto ezizimele zidayiswa emakethe evulekile; amasheya kuphela ahwebelwana lapha.
education_economy_exchange.s1_detail: Ukuchofoza kuletha lelo sheya embonelelweni: intengo yokugcina, ushintsho, inani, nomzumo walo wamanje. I-tag ye-CGC isho Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi enikeza imigomo efanayo — umsebenzi wayo uhlala usemkhakheni womphakathi phakathi nokuphuma kwesikhathi.
education_economy_exchange.s2_detail: Izibonelelo (Bids) yilokho abathengi abazokukhokha; izicelo (asks) yilokho abathengisi abakufunayo; igebe phakathi kwazo yisusa (spread). Ukutholakala kwentengo kwenzeka ngokuvulekile — wonke umuntu ubona incwadi efanayo.
education_economy_exchange.s3_detail: Isicelo esihlangene sakha isivumelwano phakathi kwamaphathi amabili futhi sigcina ezikhwameni zawo zangasese. Azikho izindlela zokukhokha, akukho ukugcinwa, akukho isitsha esihlanganyelwe — indawo ithola intengo, amaphathi aba ngumnikazi wokuhwebelana.
education_economy_exchange.s3_do: Qonda ukuthi ukuhwebelana okuhlangene kuba yini
education_economy_exchange.s4_detail: Izinto ezizimele zidayiswa endaweni eyodwa nangentengo eyodwa emakethe evulekile — le ndawo ngeyamasheya kuphela.
education_economy_exchange.s4_do: Thenga imikhiqizo emakethe evulekile esikhundleni salokhu
education_economy_help.learn: Cela usizo noma lunikeze omunye umuntu. Izicelo zingaqala njengemiklamo yangasese; ukushicilela kwenza isicelo esivulekile sibonakale kubantu abangaphendula.
education_economy_help.s1_detail: Bheka izicelo zomphakathi ezivulekile, Izicelo zami, noma Izibonelelo zami. Sebenzisa Okudlule neOkulandelayo ukuze uqhubeke nohlu.
education_economy_help.s2_detail: Siphe isihloko futhi uchaze lokho okudingayo. Gcina umklamo wangasese uma ungakakulungeli izimpendulo, noma ushicilele ukuze umeme izibonelelo zosizo.
education_economy_help.s3_detail: Funda imininingwane ngaphambi kokunikeza usizo. Ocelayo ubuyekeza izibonelelo ngokuyimfihlo futhi ukhetha umsizi; abanye abasizi ngeke bakwazi ukufunda isibonelelo sakho.
education_economy_help.s4_detail: Uma udinga i-akhawunti yezimali ngaphambi kokuthumela noma ukuphendula, ikhasi lichaza isinyathelo esilandelayo. Ukucela noma ukunikeza usizo akudluliseli imali noma akwakhi ifi elizenzakalayo.
education_economy_help_detail.learn: Gcina isicelo esisodwa kanye nezibonelelosaso ndawonye. Ocelayo ukhetha umsizi futhi uvala isicelo lapho sexuliwe noma singasadingeki.
education_economy_help_detail.s1_detail: Umklamo wangasese ubonakala kuphela kulowo ocelayo. Ukushicilela umklamo ovulekile kukumema izibonelelo; isicelo esihlangene sesinomsizi okhethiwe.
education_economy_help_detail.s2_detail: Esicelweni somphakathi esivulekile, chaza usizo ongaluphiwa. Ocelayo ubona izibonelelo; umsizi ngamunye ubona impendulo yakhe kuphela.
education_economy_help_detail.s3_detail: Ocelayo angamukela isibonelelo esisodwa. Umsizi angasusa isibonelelo sakhe; uma umsizi okhethiwe esusa isibonelelo, isicelo sivuleka futhi.
education_economy_help_detail.s4_detail: Ocelayo angasishayela njengesixazululo noma asisuse. Umlando wesicelo nempendulo uhlala ukhona kubantu abavumeleke ukuba bawufunde.
education_economy_home.learn: Konke okuhwebayo, okuvumelanayo, okuzuzayo, nokokulokhu — endaweni eyodwa. Iyunithi oyibonayo kuzo zonke izintengo iyiyunithi yokubala engashintshoki: ibala inani ngaphakathi emdlalweni futhi ayithinti imali yangaphandle — azikho izindlela zokukhokha, akukho ukugcinwa kwemali.
education_economy_home.s1_detail: Amakhadi akuholela emakethe evulekile, ekushintshanisweni, ezivumelwaneni, ewallet yakho, ema-ledger ahlanganyelwe, amayunithi nemali, esisizelo somphakathi, kwezezimali zomphakathi, nasezomnothweni wezinhlangano. Isikwele singokuxoxa; imakethe ingokuhweba.
education_economy_home.s2_detail: Ukuhamba komnotho okuphindaphindwayo kwenzeka ngesikhathi esibekwe umthetho — ukushintsha le ndlela kuthatha izintu ezimbili ezifanayo nanoma iyiphi imithetho yemali. Ngumthetho, hhayi inkinobho yokuphatha.
education_economy_home.s3_detail: Idatha yakho yezomnotho iyimfihlo yakho, njengokuvota kwephepha lokuvota. Imali ibekelwe indawo yegunya ebanzi kakhulu. Futhi imithetho yemali ihamba ngeminyango emibili kuphela — iningi elikhethekile lasekamalambeni nokuvuma kwabantu abibusa.
education_economy_home.why: Alikho ikhadi lokukhokha amalungelo omphakathi. Akukho rhafu, imali yokubhalisa, noma izindleko ezingake zihambisane nokuvota, ukuba umkhethwa, ukuhlala, noma ukwenza isicelo — ungaba mpofu lapha kodwa ungalahlekelwa yilutho olubalulekile. Ingcebo ithenga izimpahla; ayithengi ukubusa. (Art. I)
education_economy_joint_ledgers.learn: I-ledger ehlanganyelwe iyikhawunti ebiwa ngokuhlanganyela: ibhalansi yayo ngeyabantu abaningi, futhi akukho kuhamba kwemali kuze kube yilapho bonke abahlanganiswe abadingekayo bevuma. Umshayini oyedwa angeke akwazi ukuhambisa imali ehlanganyelwe eyedwa.
education_economy_joint_ledgers.s1_detai: I-ledger ngayinye ibiza abahlanganiswe bayo nomthetho wayo wokuvuma kusengaphambili — bonke abashayinayo, noma iningi, njengoba kuvunyelwe lapho ivulwa. Wonke umhlanganiswe kumele amukele ngaphambi kokuba i-ledger ibekhona.
education_economy_joint_ledgers.s2_detai: Noma yimuphi umhlanganiswe angaphakamisa ukukhokha, ukudlulisa, noma ukukhipha imali. Abantu babeka umthetho wabo nenjongo ngokukhululeka — kodwa akukho isigaba esivumelwaneni esingase sishiye ilungelo lomthethosisekelo.
education_economy_joint_ledgers.s3_detai: Isayina yakho iyeyodwa kwezinye. Ukuhamba kwemali kulinda, kukhombise ukuthi ubani ovumile nokuthi ubani osadingekayo, futhi kuphelele kuphela lapho umthetho uhlangabezana nazo.
education_economy_joint_ledgers.s4_detai: Isizinda esihlanganyelwe esingaphansi kwendawo yegunya sithunyelwa irekhodi lomphakathi, lapho ukungena kwakho konke kuhambisana nokungena kwangaphambilini ukuze umlando ungabhayiswe ngasese. I-ledger phakathi kwabantu noma izinhlangano ifundeka kuphela kubahlanganiswe bayo.
education_economy_listing_detail.learn: Isiphakamiso esisodwa, kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni — ukuthi yini, ubani oyithengisayo, nokuthi kwenzekani ngempela lapho u-oda. Isitifiketi sakho siyimfihlo: njengephepha lokuvota, umthengi nomthengisi kuphela abangalifunda.
education_economy_listing_detail.s1_deta: Intengo, inani, umthengisi nokuthi uhlobo luni lomthengisi. Isignathi se-Common Good Corp kusho imigomo efanayo nanoma yimuphi umthengisi omulawulwa kabanzi — nomsebenzi ohla phansi komphakathi unomphela.
education_economy_listing_detail.s2_deta: I-oda yakho ifayilwa ngokuhambisana nohlu. Uzibophezela ukuthenga ngentengo ebhalwe phansi; akukho okubopha kuze kube yilapho umthengisi evuma.
education_economy_listing_detail.s3_deta: Umthengisi kuphela yilowo ophelezela i-oda — umthengi angeke aqede ukuthenga kwakhe. Lapho kuvunyelwe, i-oda iba isivumelwano sezinhlangothi zombili, futhi akukho isigaba kuyo esingase sishiye ilungelo.
education_economy_listing_detail.s4_deta: Amayunithi ahamba kusuka kukhawunti ukuya kukhawunti — ukukhipha kokwakho, ukufaka kokomthengisi. Ayikho indlela yokukhokha, akukho muntu ophakathi, futhi akekho omunye ongafunda ukuhamba kwemali.
education_economy_marketplace.learn: Imakethe eyodwa, izindlela ezimbili: iziphakamiso yilokho abantu abazokunika, izicelo yilokho abantu abakudingayo. Ivulekele wonke umhlali — akukho layisense, akukho ubulungu, akukho mvume edingekayo, futhi i-app ayihloli lokho ngabomu.
education_economy_marketplace.s1_detail: Iziphakamiso yizimpahla nezinsizakalo zokuthengisa. Izicelo yizikhala zomsebenzi nomakhelwane abacela usizo. Imakethe efanayo, izindlela eziphikisana.
education_economy_marketplace.s2_detail: Ifomu elilodwa libeka impahla noma insizakalo emakethe. Umuntu, ibhizinisi, inhlangano engezinhlelayo, ne-common-good corporation zonke zibeka imigomo efanayo — akekho othola i-counter engcono.
education_economy_marketplace.s3_detail: Ukuloda kuvula ukuthenga ngokuhambisana nohlu lomthengisi. Akukho okubopha kuze kube yilapho umthengisi evuma — inkontileka yohlangothi olulodwa ayikaze isebenze.
education_economy_marketplace.s4_detail: Ayikho intengo, ayikho inkontileka — umakhelwane ocela usizo akukona ukuhweba, ngakho i-app ayifaki imishini yamakethe kukho. Yimfihlo ngokuzenzakalela — ihlanganyelwa kuphela lapho ocelayo ekhetha.
education_economy_marketplace.s4_do: Cela noma phendula ngaphansi nosizo oluhlanganyelwe
education_economy_org_settings.learn: Umbono womphathi ngempilo yezomnotho yenhlangano — ukuhlukaniseka kwebhodi layo, ama-shares, imali yokubhalisa, i-ledger, namarhafu — okwakhiwe ngomnyango ongawo nakho ukushintsha kwenhloso noma komthetho. Abadlali abaningi abadingi le khasi.
education_economy_org_settings.s1_detail: Ukuhlukana komsebenzi/umnikazi kubalwa kusukela ezivumelwaneni zomsebenzi ezirekhodiwe, akukho okuxoxiswanayo noma okumemezwayo: isihlalo sokuqala somsebenzi sifika kubasebenzi abangu-100, ukulingana kubasebenzi abangu-2,000. Ukuqasha omunye umuntu kungashintsha ibhodi.
education_economy_org_settings.s2_detail: Izinhlangano ezinama-stock zibala izigaba zama-shares nabanikazi; izinhlangano zobuhlanganyana obulinganayo nezilawulwa amalungu azina-shares nhlobo — ubunikazi bulandela isiqalo. Isikhala sobunikazi sihamba kuphela ngokudluliselwa okusayina zombili izinhlangothi. Impahla yengqondo yenkampani yenhlalakahle yomphakathi ihlala iyimfihlo yomphakathi unomphela.
education_economy_treasury.s4_do: Yazi ukuthi yini engenziwa isishayamthetho kuphela
education_economy_treasury.why: Kukhona ikhodi eyodwa kuphela kusistimu yonke engashintsha inani, futhi i-test suite ihlolwa ekhodi ukuze kuhlale kunjalo. Ngombhali oyedwa nangaphandle kweminyango eyifihliwe, "izincwadi ziyahambelana" kuyisici sesistimu uqobo — hhayi irepoti okumele othile ayigize futhi wonke umuntu ayethembe.
education_economy_units.learn: Lokhu yimali uqobo — isinyathelo sokubala, ukuthi ibiza malini, ukuthi ihlukaniseka kanjani — kanye nazo zonke izikhali ezibeka lezo zinto. Alukho ukushintsha lapha okwenziwa ngumphathi: konke kushintshwa isinqumo sesishayamthetho kuphela, futhi imali ikhiqizwa indawo yegunya ehlanganisa konke kuphela.
education_economy_units.s1_detail: Igama, uphawu, ukunembile, kanye nohlu lokuhlukaniseka. Ukuchaza isinyathelo nokuhlukaniseka kwaso kungamandla okubeka izindinganiso zokulinganisa — ulindelo olulodwa oluhlanganyelwe umfelandawonye wonke, ngakho luhlala emsulwini, futhi ayikho indawo yegunya ephansi engashicilela.
education_economy_units.s2_detail: Yonke inani elikhonjiswe — izinga lokukhipha, inhloso yokuphakama kwamanani, izilungiselelo zezibonelelo — bekubekwe isinqumo sesishayamthetho futhi sinesinqumo esisibekile. Alikho ikhasi lezilungiselelo ngemuva kweli khasi; indlela eyodwa yokubhala wumthethosivivinywa.
education_economy_units.s3_detail: Isikhali sezimali siyashintsha kuphela lapho kuvuleka iminyango emibili: iningi elikhethekile lasekamalambeni, bese kulandela ukuvuma kwezindawo zegunya zabavoti lapho imali yabo ikhona. Lapho indawo yegunya ingenabo abavoti, umnyango wesibili ugcwaliswa yona uqobo — kodwa awukhiyi neze lapho bakhona.
education_economy_units.s4_detail: Ukuthi umnotho ukhokha kanjani kuyisilungiselelo, okushintshwa isinqumo seminyango emibili njengazo zonke ezinye izikhali. Akukho okumayelana nesigqi semali okuphathwa ngumsebenzi.
education_economy_units.why: I-demo isebenzisa isinyathelo sekredithi yomphakathi, kodwa akukho lapha okuncike kulokho. Umthethosisekelo ubeka ukuthi ubani onquma nokuthi kanjani — hhayi ukuthi iyiphi imali. Umshini awuthathi uhlangothi ngokuthi kufanele kube malini imali; lowo mbuzo ungowabantu kuphela whose mali lokhu.
education_economy_wallet.learn: Ibhala lakho nazo zonke izithenjwa, kuyimfihlo njengoba iphepha lokuvota kuyimfihlo — wena wedwa ongazifunda. Akukho lapha okubamba noma okushintsha imali yangempela; isinyathelo siyilinganiso elibonakalayo lenani ngaphakathi emdlalweni.
education_economy_wallet.s1_detail: Amakhredithi angena, amadebithi aphuma, ngasinye sinokukhishwa kwalo nokukhumbula. Lolu hlu lungolwakho wedwa — alushayelwa phansi, aluhlanganyelwa, futhi aluhlanganyelwa ngokuhlanganyela.
education_economy_wallet.s2_detail: Isibonelelo somphakathi sihlala sikhona, kubo bonke — isinga esihlanganyelwa yiwo wonke umuntu kanye nokunyusa okuncane ngomsebenzi womphakathi, ngaphansi komkhawulo. Singakunika amakhredithi kuphela, hhayi ukukubamba, futhi usayizi yaso ayishintshi ukufaneleka kwakho kunoma yini.
education_economy_wallet.s3_detail: Ukudlulisela kubeka igama le-akhawunti yomamukeli, hhayi umuntu. I-akhawunti yakho itholakala ngokuzibona kwakho, futhi ifomu ngeke isetshenziswe ukuthola ukuthi ubani ongi-akhawunti. Ukukhokha okwedlula ibhala kuyenqaba; kanjalo nokuzikhokhela wena.
education_economy_wallet.why: Ukudlulisela kubheka ama-akhawunti ngoba ama-ledger aqopha inani, hhayi ubuntu. Uma ukudlulisela kwasebenzisa amagama, wonke ama-ledger angaba amaphephu abantu — ukubheka ama-akhawunti kugcina ukuthi ungubani kuhlukile ngokuphelele kulokho okubambile, ukuhlukana okufanayo nephepha lokuvota.
education_economy_work.learn: Buyekeza izicelo zakho kanye neziphakamiso, noma phatha ukuqasha lenhlangano oyimele. Isiphakamiso siba isivumelwano kuphela ngokwamukelwa komfaki kanye nesayini yenhlangano.
education_economy_work.s1_detail: Izicelo zami zikhombisa amathuba owafake izicelo zawo. Ukuqasha kukhombisa izinhlangano oyimele; khetha inhlangano bese ukhetha isikhangiso ukuze ubuyekeze abafaki.
education_economy_work.s2_detail: Abaqashi bangashicilela isikhangiso nemigomo yaso futhi babuyekeze izicelo. Ukuze uthole ithuba njengomsebenzi, vula Thola umsebenzi kuleli khasi. Uhlu lunama-link weOkudlule neOkulandelayo ukuze uhlolwe ngezinhlangano ezilawulekayo.
education_economy_work.s3_detail: Umuqashi angenza isiphakamiso noma enqabe isicelo. Umfaki angamukela imigomo enikeziwe noma asuse isicelo; ukwamukela akusayini egameni lomqashi.
education_economy_work.s4_detail: Ngemuva kokwamukelwa, umqashi usayina ukuze aqophe ukuqashwa. Vula isivumelwano esixhumekile ukuze ufunde imigomo nezayini. Kuphela kumfaki ofanele noma umele inhlangano ongakwenza okumenzela yena.
education_economy_work.why: ombili abahlanganyelayo bavuma imigomo efanayo. Ukubheka noma ukufaka isicelo akudali isivumelwano somsebenzi ngasese.
education_education_material_edit.learn: Ifomu lokushicilela kwemodyuli eyodwa: ikhi yayo, isihloko, indlela, isikrini esifundisayo, ubude bayo, nokuthi ishicilelwa njengodraft noma njengento ephilayo.
education_education_material_edit.s1_det: Ikhi nendlela ndawonye zibona imodyuli; ukulungisa kumele ibize leyo esekhona.
education_education_material_edit.s2_det: Ubuso buyisikrini lapho okuqukethwe kwe-Learn kwale modyuli kukhona; kumele kube sebebhaliswe.
education_education_material_edit.s3_det: I-Live iyishicilela kubafundi futhi ivula isango lokuqeqeshwa kwe-role; i-draft iyibamba.
education_education_material_edit.why: imodyuli iqondisa esikrinini sangempela nendleleni yangempela, ngakho umfundi uhlala efika endaweni futhi isango lihlala linomnyango. Ikhi lezimpendulo ayikho kuleli fomu — ukunikeza amamaki kuhlala ohlangothini lwe-server.
education_education_material_manager.lea: Ishelfu yomzimba obhalayo: zonke izindlela zokuqeqeshwa nemodyuli zazo, isimo semodyuli ngamunye, ukulungiswa, nokuthi ubani okugcina ukushicilela.
education_education_material_manager.s1_: Imodyuli ephilayo (Live) ivula isango lokuqeqeshwa; ama-draft awenzi njalo.
education_education_material_manager.s2_: Ukushicilela kufayila amafayela F-EDU-002; ukulungisa kwandisa ukubuyekezwa kwemodyuli futhi kugcine ikhi yayo.
education_education_material_manager.s3_: Umugqa wemodyuli uphethe isihloko, ubuso, isimo. Umbhalo wesifundo ubhalwa ku-K-2 source, hhayi lapha.
Qaphela lapho kuhlala khona umbhalo wesifundo
education_education_material_manager.why: ukushicilela kuyisenzo esifayiliwe irekhodi lomphakathi, esinikezelwe edomane lomphakathi njengomsebenzi wonke wenhlalakahle. Umugqa uyisakhiwo; amazwi ahlala komunye umthombo ukuze izihumushi zingahlukani.
education_elections_board_console.learn: Ubuso bokusebenza kwabantu abaqhuba ukukhetho — kanye nemingcele yalokho abangakuthinta.
education_elections_board_console.s1_do: Biza ukukhetho futhi uhlole ukufaneleka kwabakhethwa
education_elections_board_console.s2_det: Imingcele inezinguqulo; izinhlelo ezindala zigcinwa, azizisoli.
education_elections_board_console.s3_det: Ukuqinisekisa kwenza abanqobile bahlale ezihlalo ngokuzenzakalela. Ucwaningo nokubala kabusha kuyizenzo ezifayiliwe irekhodi lomphakathi.
education_elections_board_console.why: ibhodi iqhuba inqubo futhi ayikwazi ukuthinta ukubala. Inombolo yabagcina ishicilelwe kusengaphambili, indlela yokubala iqinisiwe kukhompyutha, kanti ukuqinisekisa kuyisikhuthazo sokuhlala esihlalweni hhayi isinqumo sokuthi ubani onqobile.
education_elections_candidacy_registrati: Indlela obeka ngayo igama lakho. Akukho okumele ukufanelele kona.
Uma uhlobene nendawo yegunya, ungama. Akukho malondo, akukho ziganiso, akukho ukusekela, akukho ukuvunyelwa.
Ibhodi ihlola into eyodwa: ukuthi ngempela uhlobene lapha. Lokhu kuwukuhlola, hhayi isahlulelo.

Noma yimuphi umhlali wezinhlangano zakho angashicilela ukusekela ubukhethwa bakho kuphrofayili yakho. Lokhu kuyisenzo sakhe somphakathi, okuyimfihlo kuze kube yilapho ekhetha ukukwenza, futhi akushintshi lutho ngolungelo lwakho lokuma. Ukusekela kungenziwa, kususwe futhi kwenziwe futhi noma nini ngenkathi ubukhethwa bakho bukhona — akukho usuku lokugcina. Akukho ukuvota okuyimfihlo kokuvuma, okungabonakali futhi okukhetha abagcina, futhi akukho ukubambisana kwenhlangano (umkhethwa ucela, umele avume), okuphethwe ngokuvuleka futhi okunikeza R-07.

education_judiciary_constitutional_chall: Indlela noma ubani angaphikisa ngayo umthetho — nendawo eyodwa ohlelweni lapho inkantolo ingashintsha khona umthetho ngokuqondile.
Noma yimuphi umhlali angafayila. Akukho mgcini wesango, akukho kufutshwa, futhi akukho ukuhlola ukufaneleka ngaphandle kokuhlala lapha.
Ijaji elihlele isihlalo lenkantolo liqopha ukuthi umthetho uyangaphikisana yini nomthethosisekelo. Ukulawula kuvela kuphela ngenkathi isicelo sokunqaba siphenyo.

Ijaji elihlele isihlalo lincoma indlela yokulungisa umthetho futhi libeke izikhathi zombili — isikhathi sesixazululo (CLK-12) nesikhathi sokuvimba (CLK-11). Ukulawula kuvela ngemuva kokutholakala kokungafani.
Ilungu lesishayamthetho somthetho ophambile livula ukuhamba komthethosivivinywa nezinselelo sezilungiselele; ukukwenza lokhu ngesikhathi esibekwe kuvala inselelo (Indlela 1).

Ilungu lalelo shishayamthetho livula ukuvota kokuchitha ukuvimba ngesikhathi sokuvimba; iningi elikhethekile lalo lonke amalungu asebenza lichitha okutholwe yinkantolo futhi umthetho uhlala ungashintshanga (Indlela 2).

Uma amawindi omabili evalwe ngaphandle kokulungiswa noma ukuchitha ukuvimba, ijaji elihlala esihlalweni lisisebenzisa isixazululo ngokuqondile — inkantolo ihlela umthetho uqobo futhi umlando ophelele wezinguqulo ugcinwe (Indlela 3). Ukuhlanza kwe-CLK-11 kukusebenzisa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi.

education_jurisdictions_disintermediatio: Isigaba esiphakathi sikahulumeni — isifunda esiphakathi kwezifunda zaso nezwe — singaxoshwa ukuze izindawo ngaphakathi kuso ziphendule ngokuqondile ezingeni elingaphezulu. Akekho okukuphimisa lokhu ngaphandle: wonke umvoti kumele avume, futhi izinga elingaphezulu kumele livume.
Isishayamthetho samukela ukuvota kokususa isigaba esiphakathi, okuvula inqubo yokuvuma kuzo zonke izindawo zamavoti nesishayamthetho esizungezile.
Ukunquma ngokunye, hhayi ukuvota kwangamathathu: wonke umvoti udlulisela isinqumo sakhe, futhi omunye ongavumi uyimisa ukuxoshwa. Izinga elingaphezulu kumele livume futhi.

Izinqumo zesigaba esixoshiwe azinyamalali — zihlanganiswa nomthetho womvoti ngamunye owake waba khona umlando ophelele wezinguqulo ugcinwe. Imibangiswano nomthetho wendawo okhona ivelele futhi isixazululo silandwe ngaphambi kokuba kube nokuthatha isinyathelo, futhi izinselelo zomthetho ezivulekile zihamba nomthetho ohlangene.
Uma ukuxoshwa kusebenza, wonke umvoti owake waba khona uphendula ngokuqondile ezingeni elingaphezulu, futhi uhlelo lwezindawo lomhlali wonke luzihlela kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Bhala isinqumo sendawo yegunya ezungezile, vula ukuvota kokuvuma kwendawo yomvoti ngamunye, futhi uqedele lapho ukunquma ngokunye nokuvuma kwendawo ezungezile konke sekukhona. Ukuqedela ngaphambi kokuba imingcele yombili ihlangane kunqanyulwa nokubhekiselwa kwayo, futhi inqubo iqedela ngokwayo ngomzuzu lapho ukuvota kokugcina kokuvuma kuvala.

Abavoti bafuna imithetho yesigaba esisuswe — futhi kusukela ngaleso sikhathi imithetho iba eyabo. Indawo ngayinye ingayishintshe noma iyikhise njengomthetho nayo owudlulisile. Ukunqandisa uhulumeni akukhishi umthetho abantu ababephila ngaphansi kwawo; kunika ipeni kubantu abaseduze nawo.
education_jurisdictions_federation.learn: Uma omakhelwane abazibusa ababili bengavumelani ngokuthi imingcele yabo ihlangana kuphi, abantu abahlala phakathi komngcele oshintshayo yibo abanquma — hhayi izishayamthetho ezizungezile. Lolu skrini isifasitela sakho sokubona okwenzeka phakathi kohulumeni; izinhlelo zezisebenzi ngemuva kwabo zihlala endaweni yophathi.
education_jurisdictions_federation.s1_de: Isiphakamiso sibhalwa futhi siphikishane obala, wonke umuntu ophakathi komngcele oshintshayo uvota enhlolovweni, bese imephu izibuyisela njengomngcele omusha onenguqulo — umlando ugcinwe.
education_jurisdictions_federation.s1_do: Landela ushintsho lomngcele ngezinyathelo zalo ezintathu
education_jurisdictions_federation.s2_de: Ukudluliswa kwalo kudinga izinhlangu ezimbili ezintathu zonke izakhelwane ezithintakele — hhayi kuphela labo avota, futhi hhayi indawo yegunya ephelele. Indawo ethintakele iyona eyivoti futhi iyona eyisisekelo sokubala.
education_jurisdictions_federation.s3_de: Uma seqondiswe, inhlangano yasekhaya yomhlali wonke othintakele ihlolwa kabusha ngokomngcele omusha. Amalungelo abuyela ngokuzenzakalelayo ohlangothini olusha lomugqa — akekho okumele abhalise kabusha.
education_jurisdictions_federation.s4_de: Uhulumeni ohlukene ungasebenza kuma-server ahlukene agcina irekhodi zakamuva zendawo ngayinye. Irekhodi lomphakathi nezimpumelelo zihamba kuleyo nethiweki; okuqukethwe iphepha lakho lokuvota nokuthunyelwa kwendawo yakho eyimfihlo akwenzi lokhu, futhi inqubo yakho yokufunda ihlala kunode yakho futhi ayifelandawonyi — nakuba ukuqedela ukuqeqeshwa okufayila kwakho kuyisenzo somthethosisekelo futhi kuhamba njengalinye lirekhodi lomphakathi. Ukusebenzisa iserver akuniki amandla obuhulumeni — inethiweki ihambisa irekhodi, hhayi igunya.
education_jurisdictions_federation.s4_do: Yazi ukuthi yini ehamba phakathi kuma-server
education_jurisdictions_federation.s5_de: Isivumelwano somngcele sivulwa lapha njengesenzo phakathi kohulumeni — akukho siphakamiso sasekamheni: nameza omakhelwane ababili nezinye izindawo zegunya ezithintakele, bhala inhlolovo yendawo ethintakele, bese yamukela. Ukwamukelwa kunqandwa ngaphandle kokuba iningi elikhethekile labantu bendawo ethintakele — hhayi indawo yegunya ephelele — lifikelele.
education_jurisdictions_place.learn: Leli ikhasi lendawo uqobo — ukuthi iyini, ihlala kuphi, inaluphi uhulumeni, nokuthi ungabamba iqhaza kanjani. Noma ubani angalifunda noma yiliphi ikhasi lendawo; ukuhlala lapho yilokho okukuvumela ukuba usebenze lapho.
education_jurisdictions_place.s1_detail: Amachiphu phezulu ayizithombo zayo, iqala ngempande. Izinye ziyizixhumanisi zekhasi lendawo uqobo, ukuze ukwazi ukukhuphuka emthini ngaphandle kwemephu.
education_jurisdictions_place.s2_detail: Isishayamthetho siba khona lapho izifunda sezidwebiwe; sihlala esihlalweni lapho ukhetho seluzigcwalisile. Isigungu esiphethe nobulungiswa buvela lapho le ndawo izidala. "Akukho okwamanje" kuyiqiniso, hhayi iphutha.
education_jurisdictions_place.s3_detail: Umbukeli wemephu ukhombisa umngcele nezindawo ngaphakathi kwalo. Kuyithuluzi elilodwa phakathi kwezinye; ikhasi lendawo lingumnyango ongukuqala.
education_jurisdictions_place.s4_detail: Isikwele somphakathi, izicelo namakamelo aqhuba manje avulekele wonke umuntu. Ukufayila ifomu lapha kudinga ukuhlala; ukufunda akudingi lokho.
education_jurisdictions_place.why: iqhaza livimba izenzo, hhayi amakhasi. Indawo ngayinye ivulekile ngoba irekhodi lomphakathi luhulumeni livulekile — ungabuka noma iyiphi indawo yegunya izibusa ngaphambi kokuba uhlale lapho.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.lear: Uma uhulumeni enguqukwe, abanjwe, noma acekelwe phansi, umthethosisekelo awumi — ukwakha kabusha kuhamba ngezinga ezintathu kuze kube yilapho uhulumeni osemthethweni ephinda esukuma. Leli khasi liwukuzilolonga kokuma, kulala kuze kube yilapho ubufakazi buthi okunye.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.s1_d: Kunqandwe, kubanjwe noma kukhishwa emsebenzini, noma kacekelwe phansi. Ukutholwa kubamba ubufakazi futhi kuqinisekiswa okutholwe yinkantolo — akukho hulumeni ongakwazi ukushintsha lokhu ngokuzimela.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.s2_d: Izinga 1: abavoti bakhetha ngokuhlanganyela isishayamthetho esisha. Izinga 2: izinga elingaphezulu libiza ukhetho kubo. Izinga 3: abantu bazihlelele izindawo zegunya ezintsha kusuka kumngcele olalala. Izinga ngalinye lisebenza kuphela lapho elingaphezulu kwalo lingakwazi ukusebenza.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.s3_d: Ukukhetha kokwakha kabusha kuphinda kusebenzise imishini yokukhetha kokuqala — eqhubwa uhlelo ngokumaqala omthethosisekelo, njengendawo evuka okokuqala.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.s4_d: Abantu abambalala ababusa ngaphandle kokuvuma, akukho mvoti onikezwe ubuhlungu kunomunye, ikhono langempela lokubusa. Amandla okuvikela abophelwe kumuntu onelungelo elisemthethweni kakhulu — hhayi ophethe isihlalo njengamanje, hhayi owanamandla kakhulu.
Uma izimbangi zizifuna izihlalo zohulumeni, ukusemthethweni kubalwa
education_jurisdictions_restoration.s5_d: Memeza isimo ngokuhambisana necase lokubuyekezwa okubophelene, ukuqinisekise — ukuqinisekisa kufunda okutholwe yinkantolo kulelo case, hhayi nginye inkinobho — bese ungena ezingeni ngokulandelana, futhi ufake isigameko njengesibuyiselwe esingeni sesithathu noma usiyeke. Izinga elingahambisani nokuphetha ngaphambi kwezinga likesithathu zonywa zombili.
education_jurisdictions_restoration.why: Noma yini esasebenza — ukukhetha, izikhathi zomhlala, inkantolo — ayikwazi ukuphazanyiswa ngenkathi ukubuyisela kuhamba, isiqiniseko esifanayo esibophela amandla esimo esiphuthumayo. Futhi ukubuyisela kusebenza njendlela yokuseka: ukumisa umhlaba kusuka emirekhodini esasele kuyisenzo esifanayo nokwakha kabusha uhulumeni olahleka.
Izindawo ezimbili noma ezingaphezulu ezizimele zihlanganiswa kunyunyana kuphela ngokuvuma kwazo — hlola lapho imithetho yawo ihlukile, vumelana nenani elilodwa elihlanganyelwe kulokho okuhlukile, bese liqinisekiswa nobabili ohlangothini. Akukho case elikhona namuhla (Umhlaba uqala uhlangene), kodwa inqubo ilungele noma yiphi indawo yegunya ezizimele esikhathini esizayo.

Ukuqhathanisa okubhekene kuqhathanisa izilungiselelo nezikhungo zakho zonke. Imishini eshiyilwe — indlela yokuvota, ubukhulu bezihlalo ezingama-5–9 zezifunda, umthetho wezinhlangu ezimbili ezintathu — ifana yonke indawo ngokuhlelwa kwayo, ngakho izinto ezishintshwayo kuphela ezingadinga ukulungiswa.
Isenzo sokuseka siqopha inani elilodwa lenyunyana ngomunye umehluko. Abavoti bagcina amanani abo endaweni yabo lapho amandla ehlanganyelwe — ukuhlanganiswa kunyunyana akukhishi umthetho wendawo.
Vumelana nenani elilodwa elihlanganyelwe kulokho okuhlukile

Ukubumbana kwenyunyana kudinga iningi elikhethekile elingashisela kwesithupha sabantu kulo lonke uhlanga olufaka isicelo kanye niningi elikhethekile lezindawo zegunya eziyizithako zenyunyana (inyunyana esaqala ayikabi nayo; lokhu kuqala kusukela ekuhlanganyeleni kwokuqala). Izibalo zisetshenziswa kubantu bonke — hhayi kuphela labo abavotayo.
Ukuphuma kuhamba ngendlela efanayo futhi kuneningi elikhethekile elifanayo nokungena. Azikho iminyango esiya ngendlela eyodwa.
Yazi ukuthi umnyango uvuleka ngezinhlangothi zombili

Uma inqubo isivuliwe, ubhala imiphumela yenhlolovo yohlanga olufaka isicelo, uvule ukuvota kokuvuma kwegumbi lakho kuleyo ndawo egunya, bese uqeda lapho zombili izilinganiso zidlulile — ukuqeda ngaphala kokuba zombili zihlangane kuyenqeleka kukhombise isizathu. Lo mhlaba usehlanganiswe ngaphansi koMhlaba, ngakho ayikho inyunyana ebumbeka manje; iminyango isiza imihlaba yesikhathi esizayo kanye nezinyunyana ezincane.

Inyunyana izalwa izibuse yona ngokwayo isishayamthetho esihlala nobabili ohlobo lwamalungu — izihlalo ngokwesibalo sabantu kanye nezihlalo ezilinganayo ngendawo yegunya eyisithako — futhi nobabili kumele bavumelane ngokuzimela ukuze isinqumo sinye sidlule. Umngane omncane ujoyina azi ukuthi angeke avele avotelwe kudeze anyamalale.
education_jurisdictions_viewer.learn: Indawo eyodwa: imingcele yayo, abantu bayo, izikhungo zayo, nokuthi uhulumeni wayo usuvukile yini.
education_jurisdictions_viewer.s1_detail: Yonke indawo yegunya ihlala phakathi kwezinye futhi ingaba nezinye ngaphakathi.
education_jurisdictions_viewer.s2_detail: Isishayamthetho, isigungu esiphethe, ubulungiswa — ngasinye sikhona noma asikho.
education_jurisdictions_viewer.s3_detail: Uhulumeni uqala lapho abahlali bangempela abanele beqinisekisile lapho. Kuze kube yilapho, isikhala sikhona kodwa akukho okubusayo.
education_jurisdictions_viewer.why: indawo yonke emhlabeni ikhona ohlelweni kusukela ekuqaleni, kodwa akukho okubusa kuze kube lapho abantu bangempela behlala khona futhi bashiye lokhu kwaziwe. Izikhungo zilandela abahlali, hhayi okuphambili.
education_learn_guides.learn: Yonke indlela yokwenza isekhasi elilodwa elingafunwa — inqubo evamile yakho konke ongakwenza, ihlelwe ngokwezigaba zohlelo okungukuthi eyikuphi. Incwadi yomqondo ikhona ngaphakathi ohlelweni, hhayi endaweni okumele uyofuna kuyo.
education_learn_guides.s1_detail: Bhala lokho ozama ukukwenza — izinqubo ezihambisana nalokho zivuleka lapho, kanti konke okunye kuyasuka.
education_learn_guides.s2_detail: Izinyathelo ezinombolo, imithetho ngemuva kwesinye isinyathelo, ifilimu eyikhombisayo, nendlela yokubika inkinga ngqo ephandle. Izinqubo zabasebenzi bamajhadi zivelele, ukuze wazi ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi yiziphi ezimayelana nokusebenzisa uhlelo kunokubusa ngalo.
education_learn_guides.s3_detail: Uma kungekho okuhambisana nalokho, isimo esingenalutho sikunika ifomu lokubika — umhlahlandlela oshodayo uyitikethi, nokulifayila yikona okwenza omunye umuntu athole impendulo.
education_learn_home.learn: Yonke ithuluzi liza nesifundo esifushane: ividiyo olimini lwakho, inqubo evamile, ukuhlola okusheshayo, nomnyango oqondile emsebenzini ophilayo. Konke kuvulelekile kuwo wonke umsebenzisi — futhi akukho okudingekayo kulelo.
education_learn_home.s1_detail: Kukhona imigqa eyisithupha eqala ekuqaleni kuya ekusebenziseni ijhadi, futhi isifundo ngasinye simile sodwa. Akukho okudingekayo ngaphambi kwalokhu, akukho kubhalisa, futhi akukho gama okumele ulibambe noma ulifune — konke ukuqeqeshwa kuvulelekile kuwe.
education_learn_home.s2_detail: Ibhala libala izifundo eziphothulwe. Likhona ngenxa yakho — ukuqeda izifundo akuniki ivoti, isihlalo, noma ikhono obungengenalo.
education_learn_home.s3_detail: Ukuqeda kufayila ukuqeqeshwa ngaphansi kohlelo lomthethosisekelo njengoba kuyisenzo somphakathi futhi kukhokha isisizelo sokuqeqeshwa kanye kuphela. Kanye kusho kanye: irekhodi lezimpumelelo likhumbula ukuqeqeshwa konke okupothulile, ngakho ukuphinda akukhokhi kabili.
education_learn_home.s4_detail: Izifundo zamahhala zeCoalition zibamba imigomo, izibalo zokuvota, nomthethosisekelo ophelele. Kuyinketho, ngaso sonke isikhathi.
education_learn_home.why: Ukufunda akulona isivimbelo. Ilungelo lakho lokuvota nokuma emsebenzini livela ekuhlala kuphela (Art. I) — akukho kuqeqeshwa, uhlobo lokuhlola, noma isitifiketi esingabekwa phambi kwalokho. Lezi zifundo zikhona ukuze ukwenze ube nekhono emandleni, hhayi ukunquma ukuthi ubani obathola.
education_learn_lesson.learn: Isifundo esisodwa yividiyo emfushane, inqubo evamile esifundisayo, ukuhlola okusheshayo, nomnyango othi "manje ukwenze live" ohambela emsebenzini wangempela. Ukuhlola kufundisa — akukala, futhi akukhumbuli.
education_learn_lesson.s1_detail: Ifilimu ikhombisa umsebenzi olimini lwakho; inqubo evamile ngaphansi kwayo ibala izinyathelo ezinombolo nomthetho ngemuva kwasinye.
education_learn_lesson.s2_detail: Khetha impendulo bese ufunda incazelo noma yikuphi. Izimpendulo zakho azibhalwa neze — hhayi ukuthi ukhethe eyiphi, hhayi ukuthi kuthathe imizamo emingaki — futhi ukhiye wezimpendulo uhlala kuseva, awuthunyelwa kudivayisi yakho. Phinda njengoba uthanda.
education_learn_lesson.s3_detail: Ukuqeda kufayila ukuphothulwa kokuqeqeshwa ngaphansi kohlelo lomthethosisekelo, kubhale iqiniso elilodwa kuphela: ukuthi uliqedile. Lokho kufayila kufanayo kukhokha isisizelo sokuqeqeshwa kanye kuphela — kanye ngaso sonke ukuqeqeshwa, okukhunjulwa irekhodi lezimpumelelo.
education_learn_lesson.s4_detail: Umnyango ongaphansi ukufaka ohambweni langempela isifundo esifundisile. Lapho kuyikona okubalulekile — ukuzijwayeza kuphela lapha, ukubamba iqhaza kuqala lapho.
education_learn_lesson.why: Yiziphi izifayela zokuqedela, akukho mpendulo — irekhodi ikhona ukuze ukhokhelwe kanye futhi kufakwe uphawu lokuphumelela, hhayi ukuze uhlolwe. Futhi ukuqedela akuniki lutho ngaphandle kwalokho: akukho vote, akukho isihlalo, nakukho isikhundla ongakashongo ngoba uhlala lapha (Art. I).
education_learn_video_library.learn: Khetha ifilimu, bese ukhetha umsindo nezincazelo zayo. Ilayibrari ibala imibhalo etholakalayo; ukudlala okungokoqobo kudinga nomphakathi wezimedia we-instance kanye nemikhondo etholakalayo.
education_learn_video_library.s1_detail: Khetha isihloko elayibrari ukuze usifake kumdlali ongenhla. Inani lomsindo nezincazelo zikhombisa izinketho zolimi ze-catalog.
education_learn_video_library.s2_detail: Xhumana umsindo nezincazelo ukuze usebenzise ulimi olulodwa kokubili, noma uzihlukanise ukuze ukhethe ngasinye ngokuhlukile. Ungacima izincazelo. Umdlali uyakhumbula izinketho zakho kule browser.
education_learn_video_library.s3_detail: Sebenzisa play, pause, kanye neline timeline lapho imediya itholakala. Ukuloda, buffering, nokuhluleka kokudlala kukhonjiswa kumdlali; umkhondo ongatholakali unesenzo sokuzama futhi.
education_learn_video_library.s4_detail: Vula izifundo ezigcwele ku-Learn ukuze uthole izifundo ezibhalwe phansi nokuhlola ulwazi. Ukuba nengeniso ye-catalog noma isikhala asisho ukuthi ifilimu isishicilelwe isifundo ngasinye.
Umthethosivivinywa lapha ingxoxo ongayivula ngenkathi ihamba, hhayi idokhumenti oyithola emva kwesikhathi — inqubekela yayo, imisho yayo exoxiswana ngayo, nokukhuluma komphakathi ngayo, konke kusekhasi elilodwe.

Okulungiselelwe → ikomiti → ukufundwa phambi kwebandla → ukuvota kwebandla → umthetho. Izigaba zishintsha njengoba umthethosivivinywa uhamba, futhi ukuchofoza kanye kukufaka egallery yeseshini yebandla elinquma ngalo.

Izinguquko eziphakanyiswe zivela njengemigqa ebomvu ezahlaziyweni ezithile, ngasinye sinesizathu saso, ukuze lokho okuzoshintsha — nokuthi kungani — kuhlale lucacile kunoma ubani. Imibono nemigqa ebomvu ukukhuluma komphakathi ngomthethosivivinywa, kuhlukaniswe nerekhodi esemthethweni eligcina izigaba nokubala kwamavoti.

Umsila wemibono uvulekile. Ukuze ubhale amazwi akho erekhodini esemthethweni, uwafake njengobufakazi ehholo lapho kuzwakala khona umthethosivivinywa — kuvalwe phakazi kwesibizo sakho, hhayi igama lakho somthetho.
Yisho okwakho — kabili uma ukushoyo ngempela

Uma umthethosivivinywa usephelile waba umthetho, noma yimuphi umhlali angawuphikisa ngokuthi awuhambisani nomthethosisekelo. Uma amajaji evuma, isixazululo singashintsha umbhalo womthetho ngokuqondile — kugcinwe umlando ogcwele wonke uhlobo.
education_legislature_bill_detail.learn: Umthethosivivinywa owodwa: umbhalo wawo, ikomiti yawo, amavoti wawo, kanye nomngcele onqamile okumele awunqobe.
education_legislature_bill_detail.s1_det: Yonke inguqulo igcinwe. Akukho okushintshwa ngokubhala phezu kwakho.
education_legislature_bill_detail.s2_det: Ukuvota kwekomiti kuqala, bese kulandela ibandla.
education_legislature_bill_detail.s3_det: Izinqumo ezijwayelekile zidinga iningi; ezinye zidinga izifunda ezimbili ezintathu zabo bonke amalungu asebenza. Umngcele uvela kulokho isinqumo esikwenzayo — akukhethwa yilowo obala.
education_legislature_bills.learn: Yonke imithetho ephakanyiswe kule ndawo yegunya, nokuthi yilapho okufike khona ngasinye.
education_legislature_bills.s1_detail: Imithethosivivinywa ivulekile emphakathini kusukela ekethweni, hhayi ekuphaseni.
education_legislature_bills.s3_detail: Usayizi nombangela womthethosivivinywa kuvinjwe lapho ulethwa — awukwazi ukukhula kancane ube okuthile okuhlukile endleleni.
education_legislature_committee_detail.l: Ikomiti eyodwa isebenza — imihlangano, uhlelo, amavoti, kanye nombiko elithumela emuva.
education_legislature_committee_detail.s: Usihlalo ubiza umhlangano futhi ubeke uhlelo.
Bona ukuthi ihlangana nini nokuthi yini okusehlelweni
Amalungu ekomiti avota lapha ngaphambi kokuba noma yini ifike ebandleni.
Ikomiti ithumela umthethosivivinywa ebandleni futhi ifake umbiko oba irekhodi lomphakathi.
education_legislature_committees.learn: Indlela igumbi elihlukanisa ngayo umsebenzi walo, nokuthi amalungu agcina kanjani emakomiti aqhamukile.
education_legislature_committees.s1_do: Bona amakomiti nokuthi obani abahlala kuwo
education_legislature_committees.s2_do: Hlela ikomiti ngayinye ngokulandelana kokukhetha kwakho
education_legislature_committees.s3_deta: Ukukabelwa akuncikile eqoqweni. Izindawo zihlonipha ukulandelana kokuhlela futhi zisabalala ngokulinganayo phakathi kwamalungu — izibalo zihlukana ngokuningi okukodwa. Ukulingana kuxazululwa ngelungu elinephonshe lokuvota elikhulu ngemuva kokulungisa ama-quota.
education_legislature_committees.why: lohu wumshini ogcina amakomiti elingana ngaphandle kwesigaba seqoqo. Amalungu asekelwa izinhlangano eziningi namalungu angenaso nanye aphathwa ngendlela efanayo — alikho iqoqo lokuhlelwa kulo.
education_legislature_districts.learn: Imephu uqobo lwayo — ukuthi izihlalo zesishayamthetho zihambisana kanjani nezindawo zangempela.
education_legislature_districts.s1_detai: Izinhlelo zezifunda zinama-version: ukwamukela entsha kugcina endala, akukaze kuyisayidwe.
education_legislature_districts.s2_detai: Isifunda ngasinye sikhetha phakathi kwesihlanu nesishiyagalolunye.
education_legislature_districts.s3_detai: Ukudweba kuyisinqumo esifayilwe ibhodi lokukhetho, irekhodi lomphakathi.
education_legislature_districts.why: amephu anama-version asho ukuthi ushintsho lomngcele lungahlale luqhathaniswa nalokho olukhululwe. Ukuhlela kabusha izifunda ongakwazi ukubona okwakukhona phambi nokuba kube khona akukwazi ukubuyezwa.
education_legislature_emergency_powers.l: Amandla ayingozi kakhulu emthethosisekelo, nezinto ezintathu ezilawula alo.
education_legislature_emergency_powers.s: Amandla esimo esiphuthumayo asebenzayo akhonjiswa kukulokhu kukhona ikhasi lohlelo, awufihli lapha.
Ingozi noma ukuhlasela kuphela. Izizathu ziqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuba kuvotwe, hhayi ukuthi kuxoxwe ngazo ngemuva.
Izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu, obukhulu. Ukuvuselelwa kuwukuvota kabusha, akukaze kube ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi isilinganiso asikwazi ukunyuswa nayisiphi isinqumo.
education_legislature_emergency_powers.w: ukuhluleka kwamanla esimo esiphuthumayo emlandweni konke kuwukuhluleka kokukhitha, hhayi kokungena. Ngakho ukukhitha kuzenzakalelayo: isikhathi siqhubeka noma ngabe kukhona okhumbula ukusimisa.
education_legislature_index.learn: Yonke isishayamthetho ongakubona lapha, kuzo zonke izinga zokuhlanganiswa.
education_legislature_index.s1_detail: Indawo ingaba nenye kuzo zonke izinga — kusukela emakhelweni kuya emhlabeni.
education_legislature_index.s2_detail: Izifunda zikhetha abamele abahlanu kuya kweshiyagalolunye ngasinye. Isishayamthetho sakhiwe izifunda futhi silingana ngempande yesithathu yezahlalo — izindawo ezinkulu zithola izifunda eziningi, hhayi amaqelo amakhulu.
education_legislature_institution_acts.l: Phakamisa isikhungo kuqala; ukuqashwa nokukhetho kulandela isichazelo saso esamukelekile.
education_legislature_institution_acts.s: Isishayamthetho esikhethiwe sinikeza indawo yegunya namahhovisi anomthwalo. Ukupheka abalungu lebhodi namajaji kwenzeka ngemuva kokudaleka.
Sebenzisa ivoti lomphakathi elikhonjiswe nesinqumo. Imiyala ivela emshinini yokuvota; uSomlomo uvota kuphela ukuze axazulule ukulingana okufanele.
Ukuguqulwa kwesigungu esiphethe nokubulungiswa kukhombisa isinqumo sendawo yegunya ngasinye. Vula isishayamthetho esibambisana naso ukuze sifayile ivoti laso lokuvuma.
education_legislature_institution_acts.w: Isiphakamiso, isinqumo somphakathi nesikhungo esiphuma kuso kuhleleka; ukudala ihhovisi akuniki igunya lakho kumphakamisi.
education_legislature_legislature_home.l: Isishayamthetho sendawo eyodwa: obaphethe izihlalo zaso, lokho esikwamukile, nalokho esikusebenza kulo.
education_legislature_legislature_home.s: Izihlalo zivela ekukhethweni, zigcwaliswe ngokulingana. Amalungu avele nezinhlangano ezisekelile, Uma zikhona — ukugijima ungasekelwa kuyinto eyinhle.
Ukuhlala esihlalweni kuyisenzo sakho; akekho okufaka ngesifungo.
Ikamu lizamukela imithetho yalo yokuhleleka kanye nomthetho wokuziphatha ngokwalo.
Izishayamthetho zakha amakomiti, amabhodi okukhetho namahhovisi okuphatha — izikhungo konke okunye okusebenzayo.
education_legislature_legislature_home.w: isishayamthetho sincane ngenhloso. Izifunda zikhetha abamele abahlanu kuya kwelingane; isishayamthetho sakhiwe ngezifunda futhi sikhula ngokwe-cube root yezahlalo. Izindawo ezinkulu zithola izifunda eziningi, hhayi amaqelo amakhulu.
education_legislature_oversight.learn: Indlela isishayamthetho esibamba ngayo abaphethe izikhundla — kuhlanganise amalungu aso — ukuba babezwe.
education_legislature_oversight.s1_detai: Ukususa, ukucasula, ukugxekisa nokuxoshwa konke kuhamba ngekamu.
education_legislature_oversight.s2_detai: Ukususa kudinga iningi elikhethekile lawo wonke amalungu akhonza — imigomo efanayo kuwo wonke umuntu, kunoma isiphi isikhundla. Ukulingana kokususa kusho ukuthi akukho sikhundla kulula ukususa kuso kunesinye.
education_legislature_oversight.s3_detai: Lapho isihlalo siba namuntu, kumemezelwa, futhi ukubala kwenziwa kabusha emaphepheni okuvota okuqala kunokuba kubizwe ukukhetho okusha.
education_legislature_oversight.why: ukubala kabusha kuyinto ejwayelekile — wonke amaphepha okuvota adlulile abalwa, ngaphandle kokuhlunga noma kuphi enqubweni. Abavoti abakhethe ikamu yibo abanquma omdala.
education_legislature_overview.learn: Isishayamthetho esisodwa emongo: indawo yegunya, izifunda zaso, izihlalo zaso nesikhathi sakho.
education_legislature_overview.s2_detail: Izikhathi nezikhala zivela erejista yezilungiselelo, ngaphansi kwemingcele yomthethosisekelo.
education_legislature_referendums.learn: Lapho isishayamthetho sibuyisela isinqumo kubantu, nokuthi kwenzekani emphumeleni.
education_legislature_referendums.s2_det: Kutholakala ohlobo lwesinqumo, akukwazi ukulungiswa. Noma ubani obhala inhlolovo akakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi kunzima kangakanani ukuyiphasa.
education_legislature_referendums.s3_det: Isinqumo senhlolovo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwe — kodwa kuphela ngendlela umthethosisekelo owumise, hhayi ngokubhala kabusha okuvamile.
education_legislature_session_console.le: Umhlangano ngenkathi wenzeka — ukuba khona, ikhoramu, uhlelo, nokuvota konke njengoba kwenziwa.
education_legislature_session_console.s2: Ikhoramu yiningi lawo wonke amalungu akhonza — hhayi lowo ofikile. Izihlalo ezingenamuntu zibala ekuhlaleni kwayo.
education_legislature_session_console.s3: Izicelo, izitatimende zirekhodi, nokuvota kwendlu konke kwenzeka lapha futhi konke kufika irekhodi eliphilayo.
education_legislature_session_console.wh: ukubala ngokuhambisana nawo wonke amalungu akhonza yikona itshelelo. Kusho ukuthi ukungabikho akukwazi ukunciphisa imigomo — awukwazi ukuphasa okuthile ngokushiya igumbi lingenamuntu.
education_legislature_settings.learn: Izilungiselelo isishayamthetho esivumele ukuzishintsha, imingcele okufanele bahlale ngaphakathi kwayo, nalezo okungeke kube nomuntu ozishintshayo.
education_legislature_settings.s1_detail: Izikhala zokukhetho, imingcele, ubude bezikhathi — igama elingashintshwa.
education_legislature_settings.s2_detail: Izilungiselelo zishintshwa isinqumo esijwayelekile, phakathi kwemingcele evaliwe.
education_legislature_settings.s3_detail: Isixazululo esingaphansi kwemingcele siyalelewa ngaphambi kokuba kuvotwe — awukwazi ukudlulisa isilungiselelo esingaphansi komthethosisekelo bese uqala ukuxusa kamuva.
education_legislature_settings.why: kukhona iminyango emibili kuphela. Izilungiselelo zishintshwa izinqumo ezijwayelekile phakathi kwemingcele emisiwe; uxanduva oluqinile lushintshwa kuphela ngokukhishwa kwe-software edlula ukuhlola komthethosisekelo womphakathi. Alikho isango likesithathu, futhi akukho ningi noma kuphi elingalivula.
education_legislature_speaker_tools.lear: Lokho usomlomo angakwenza ngempela — okuncane kunalokho abantu abaningi abakucabangayo.
education_legislature_speaker_tools.s1_d: Biza izikhathi zomhlangano futhi ubeke uhlelo
education_legislature_speaker_tools.s2_d: Zombili zingezinqumo zomphakathi, hhayi ukugcinwa kwamabhuku kwangaphakathi.
education_legislature_speaker_tools.s3_d: Usomlomo akavoti ukuvota okuvamile. Ivoti lokuqinisekisa likhona kuphela ukuxazulula ukungavumelani.
education_legislature_speaker_tools.s4_d: Usomlomo uhola izinqubo zokususa ezigodini nokukweba; ikhamu livota.
education_legislature_speaker_tools.why: usihlalo uhola ekamelweni, akusibusi. Wonke amandla lapha angokwenqubo.
education_operator_console.learn: Izilawuli ze-node oyiphathayo, nezinqumo ezirekhodiwe lapho uzisebenzisa.
education_operator_console.s2_detail: Izinqumo zomsebenzi zirekhodiwe njengezinqumo zomsebenzi. Azikaze zibe zizifayila zomthethosisekelo futhi azingenile ekhoneni lokubusa.
education_operator_console.s2_do: Qaphela lokho okusezingeni lomsebenzi, hhayi elomthethosisekelo
education_operator_dns.learn: I-Identity Broker inika abalingani amagama abo nezitifiketi ezifakazela lawa magama — indlela i-node efakazela ngayo ukuthi iyona. Yinto enzima kakhulu umsebenzi angayenza, ngoba ukuqamba igama lomlingani kuthinta ingxenye yalo mlingani kunetwork.
education_operator_dns.s1_detail: I-token evumela i-broker ukuba ibhale amarekhodi amagama igcinwe ngokufihlakele futhi ibhalwe kuphela — isethiwe kanye, ayisakhonyiswa futhi, ayirekhodiwe, futhi iyaphuma kuleli bhokisi kuphela njengekhophi evaliwe ye-failover broker oyikhethile. I-broker iyisebenzisa; akukho okuyifunda futhi.
education_operator_dns.s1_do: Bhalisa i-domain futhi ubeke i-write token yayo kanye
education_operator_dns.s2_detail: I-broker ikhomba igama ekhelini lakho ngaphambi kokuba icele igunya lamasitifiketi lamahhala (Let's Encrypt) ubufakazi, nokuhlola isabelomali phakathi — igunya livumela imizamo embalwa ngeviki (50 nge-domain, 5 ngegama eliqondile), ngakho ukwenqaba kufika nokulungiswa futhi akubizi lutho.
education_operator_dns.s3_detail: Isitifiketi esisodwa egameni elilodwa kuphela yisona esijwayelekile futhi yindlela eyodwa engavimbeki namuhla. Izitifiketi ze-Wildcard nabahlinzeki bezim 자동izathu ezingeyona i-Cloudflare abakabiwa okwamanje; umhlinzeki we-Manual usebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi — ukunika irekhodi eqondile yokubeka ngesandla.
education_operator_dns.s4_detail: Ukubhala amagama ngaphansi kwe-domain, noma ukudala imvume, kungasebenza phakathi kwendawo yomunye umlingani. Lezo zindlela zilinde imvume yabo abalingani abathintakele — ngaphezulu kwanoma yikuphi ukuvota kokuvuma. Ukuqamba igama kuyikhono, hhayi isikhundla: akuthengi kuvoti, isihlalo, noma ukubamba iqhaza.
education_operator_dns.s4_do: Qaphela lapho umlingani kufanele athi yebo
education_operator_home.learn: Ukusebenzisa i-node — ama-server avontela umhlaba osebenzisa zona. Ukuyigcina isebenza akuthengi kuvoti futhi akuthengi isihlalo.
education_operator_home.s2_detail: Ukusebenza kwengqalasizinda akuniki amandla obuholi nakancane.
education_operator_home.why: noma ubani obamba izikhiye angaba namandla njalo. Ngakho i-app ayibeki lutho ngemuva kwaleso sango — akukho khondo, akukho kuvoti, akukho isihlalo — futhi isho lokho ngokukhulu esikrinini sasekhaya somsebenzi.
education_operator_identity.learn: Indlela le-instance efakazela ngayo ukuthi iyona kubala amanye amaningi enetwork.
education_operator_identity.s1_detail: Ukuzazi (Identity) yindlela i-Full Faith and Credit esebenza ngayo — umlingani kufanele azi ukuthi irekhodi yobani ayithemba.
education_operator_identity.s2_detail: Ukuzazi kwe-node akusona ukuzazi kwanoma yimuphi umuntu.
education_operator_mesh.learn: Iziphi ezinye izibonelo le nodi ekhuluma nazo, nokuthi kanjani.
education_operator_mesh.s1_detail: Umfelandawonye ungaqhamukela phakathi kohulumeni ophelele, hhayi phakathi kwabasebenzisi.
education_operator_mesh.s2_detail: Irekhodi lomphakathi nezinto ezitholwe zihamba. Amaphepha lokuvota, izinkamisa, inqubo yemfundo nomdwebo wezohlelo lwezokuphathana oluyimfihlo azikho.
education_operator_moderation.learn: Wena ugcina amaqhinga; awuzange ube njengejaji inkulumo. Lesi sikhrini sikhombisa izizathu ezine kuphela zomthethosisekelo lapho isithamo singasuswa khona — kanye nezinga lomthetho lomhlaba wangempela, okungasebenza kulo ngamunye — nokuthi lelo gunya lihamba kanjani liye kujaji, ngokuzenzakalela, ngomzuzu lapho kukhona uhulumeni.
education_operator_moderation.s1_detail: Isinyathelo sobulungiswa, esivikela amalungelo omunye umuntu, ukuvimba kwakho kwakho, nokulwa nokuthumela imilayezo engadingeki (anti-spam) okungathinti okuqukethwe. Alikho isizathu sesihlanu — ukulawula "ukususa ngenxa yokuqukethwe" akunalo ikhodi, ngakho akekho ongaphuthumelwa ukuba akusebenzise. Ukususa konke ohlangothini lweseva kubhalwa; ukuvimba kwakho akusona ukususa — kuhlunga isikhrini sakho kuphela futhi akulawulwa.
education_operator_moderation.s2_detail: Ngaphambi kokuba isishayamthetho sihlale ezihlalweni, ibhodi lomsebenzi lidlulisa ukususa ukuvikela amalungelo — okungathinti, okubhalwe, nokumakishwa ukuze kungalashwa nokuthi kuyisinqumo sejaji. Ibhodi lidlulisa; alithathi sinqumo.
education_operator_moderation.s3_detail: Ngomzuzu lapho isishayamthetho sihlala khona, ijaji elihlala esihlalweni kuphela elingaqondisa ukususa kobulungiswa noma ukuvikela amalungelo, nokudlulisa komsebenzi kuyayeka ukuhlonishwa. Akekho oshintsha iswitshi — ushintsho luwumphumela wamaqiniso.
education_operator_moderation.s4_detail: Izinto ezingekho emthethweni ezivele sezithunyelwe — ukufana kwesithombe okwaziwe ukuthi akukho emthethweni, incwadi yegunya lenkantolo ethile, isongo lokusongela okuyiqiniso — zisuswa ngaphansi komthetho wezwe lapho iseva ikhona ngokomzimba. Uhlu luvaliwe futhi lukhula kuphela ngokukhishwa kwekhodi; isinqumo ngasinye singokomuntu, hhayi ihlungu elihlala khona; irekhodi lobufakazi elivaliwe lingengezwa kuphela.
education_operator_moderation.s4_do: Sebenzisa inga lomthetho lapho umthetho womhlaba wangempela uwuphoqela
education_operator_moderation.why: umsebenzi angahlale ekhipha ugesi — lokho kuyizimiso zemvelo. Ngakho ikhodi ayiniki umsebenzi isenzo sokucenzura: ifomu yokususa ikhona kuphela ngezizathu ezimbili ezivikeleke ngokusebenza — ukuvimba kwakho nokulwa nokuthumela imilayezo engadingeki akuthinti ifomu nhlobo, ukusetshenziswa kwakho konke kuhlala irekhodi ephala, nokuthi ngomzuzu lapho kukhona uhulumeni wangempela igunya lokudlulisa linyamalala. Isiqiniseko asikona ubuntu bomsebenzi — kodwa ukungabikho kokulawula.
education_operator_roles.learn: Ukuthembana phakathi kwama-node, okumele kube amandla athile kunokuba kube igunya elibanze.
education_operator_roles.s1_detail: Ukuthemba kuhlangene — ontanga abathembekile ngomzila owodwa abathembekile kubo bonke.
education_operator_roles.s1_do: Bona ukuthi ontanga ngamunye bathembeke ngani
education_operator_setup.learn: Izinyathelo ezinhlanu zithatha ibhokisi elingenalutho libe yi-node esebenzayo ku-mesh: funa i-akhawunti yomsebenzi, nikeza igama elisibonelo, khetha ukuthi i-node izokwenziwani, shesha ukusetha kwayo, hamba. Akukho kulokhu okuthenga ivoti, isihlalo, noma ukubamba iqhaza — ukuqhuba i-node kuyisisekelo, hhayi amandla.
education_operator_setup.s1_detail: Iphasiwedi yakho isebenza kuleli bhokisi kuphela. Amanye amabhokisi akubona ngokuba nekhizi ledivayisi — ingxenye yomphakathi kuphela eyibhaliswayo, futhi ayikho iphasiwedi ephindwa phakathi kwamabhokisi.
education_operator_setup.s2_detail: Igama lihlelo elijwayelekile; i-self-URL yikheliso ontanga abashayela khona ukuze bahlangane nawe. I-server id ezimile yenziwa ngokuhamba kwokuqala futhi ihlala ngisho noma igama lishintshwa.
education_operator_setup.s3_detail: Ugcinile weRekhodi — ogcina ikhophi yirekhodi lomphakathi — yiwinda kuphela owulishintsha wena, ngokuchofoza kanye, ngaphandle kokuvunyelwa. Uma kukhona i-mesh noma uhulumeni ohlala esihlalweni, konke okunye kuleli qhude kungacelwa kuphela: ukuvunyelwa kuza ebhodini lomsebenzi ngenkathi kungekho isishayamthetho esihlala esihlalweni, kuza kuhulumeni ohlala esihlalweni ngomzuzu lapho uba khona — futhi ontanga abathintwa endaweni yabo kumele bavume futhi.
education_operator_setup.s4_detail: Ama-akhawunti omsebenzi awunalo uxhumano nama-akhawunti ezakhamuzi, futhi akukho okukwenzayo lapha okushintsha lokho ozokwenza kunakho konke okungenziwa sakhamuzi. Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuza ekuhlala kuphela — igumbi leseva aliniki lutho kulokhu.
education_operator_setup.s4_do: Yazi ukuthi lokhu kukuthengela yini: lutho
education_operator_setup.why: indima yokuchofoza kanye iyile ekuniki ukuphatha kwakho phezu kwanoma ubani — ukugcina ikhophi yirekhodi ontanga wonke asebeyinayo. Amandla wonke athinta abanye abantu (ukubaphakela, ukubanika amagama, ukugcina amaqhinga abo) kumele anikezwe ngaphandle kwebhokisi. Uma kukhona i-mesh noma uhulumeni ohlala esihlalweni, umnikazi womshini akakwazi ukuzinika igunya.
education_operator_versioning.learn: Iphi inguqulo yekhodi yomthethosisekelo leli sibonelo eliyisebenzisayo, nokuthi kungani lokho kuyiqiniso lomphakathi.
education_operator_versioning.s1_detail: Ukuqiniseka okukhulu kuhlala ekhodini, ngakho ikhodi eyisinqumo somthethosisekelo.
education_operator_versioning.s2_detail: Lona ngumzila kuphela lapho imithetho eqinile ishintsha khona — ukukhishwa okudlula ezinhlolweni zomthethosisekelo zomphakathi.
Ukuthi ibhodi lenhlangano ikhethwa kanjani — nokuthi kungani izihlalo ezithile zikhethwa ngabasebenzi.
Izihlalo ezikhethwe ngumnikazi nezikhethwe ngabasebenzi zihlala ebhodini elilodwa.
Ukukhethwa kumnikazi nokwabasebenzi kulawulwa ngokuhlukile ngummeli.
Usihlalo awunalo ikilasi — usihlalo ohlanganyelwe awubangi nakuliphi uhlangothi.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.learn: Inkampani enenqaba yokusebenzela umphakathi — nomthetho owodwa owenza ihlukile kunazo zonke ezinye izinkampani.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.s1_de: Yadalwa isinqumo sesishayamthetho, ukuze isebenze injongo yomphakathi.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.s2_de: Konke Inkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi ekudala — amapayisithi, imfihlo yezohwebo, imisebenzi enamalungelo okushicilela — kusemkhakheni womphakathi yonke indawo phakade.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.s3_de: Lesi simo singapheli. Angeke sathengiswa, sanikezwa imvume, noma sishintshwe yinoma isiphi isinqumo esizayo.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.s4_de: Umphathi ohleli esigungwini esiphethe obhekile ufayila izizathu; isishayamthetho esidale isinqumo ngokweminingi ejwayelekile yawo wonke amalungu asebenza. Ukususa kuwukuqasha nokuxosha, hhayi imishini yeningi elikhethekile.
education_organizations_cgc_detail.s4_do: Njengomphathi wesigungu esiphethe obhekile, cela ukususa ilungu lebhodi
education_organizations_cgc_detail.why: lesi yisigaba esibukhali kakhulu emthethosisekelweni. Umsebenzi wenkampani yenjongo yomphakathi ungowabo bonke, phakade, engenalo nanye ithuluzi lokukwenza kube yinto eyimfihlo.
