education_organizations_org_detail.learn: Ubuso bomphakathi benhlangano eyodwa — ubunikazi, ibhodi, ukusekela, nendlela yokuhlanganisa.
education_organizations_org_detail.s2_de: Umkhethwa ucela (F-CAN-002); i-agent inikeza (F-ORG-002), okwenziwa kube ngomphakathi futhi kunikeze R-07 kumkhethwa.
education_organizations_org_detail.s3_de: Ubulungu nomsebenzi yizindlela ezihlukene ezinemiphumela eyahlukene.
education_organizations_org_detail.s4_de: Amukela noma wenqabe isicelo ngasinye esilindile; ukuwenqaba kugcina isicelo saleyo nkathi, futhi umuntu angaphinda afake isicelo. Dlulisela igunya kunoma ngubani obhalisiwe — ukudlulisela kwenzeka ngokushesha futhi kususa ukuphatha kuwe khona manje.
education_organizations_org_detail.s4_do: Njenge-agent, hlola izicelo futhi udlulisele igunya
education_organizations_org_detail.s5_de: Nikeza umuntu oyedwa ibhakhethi yomsebenzi eyodwa — iphrofayili, ubulungu, amakontrakthi, imibhalo, ukuqasha, noma amasheya. Ummeleli usebenza kuphela kuleyo bhakhethi futhi akabambi isikhundla somthethosisekelo. Igunya ngokwalo, ukunikeza igunya, nokunqamula akukaze kudluliselwe omunye. Khansela noma yikuphi ukuphiwa noma nini.
education_organizations_org_detail.s5_do: Njenge-agent, nikeza umsebenzi omelele, bese uwukhansela
education_organizations_org_detail.why: ukuxhumana kokusekela kukhulisa ukulingana, hhayi isigaba seqembu. Inani labasebenzi likhulisa isikalo sokuzinqumela. Imodeli yenhlangano eyodwa ithwele zombili.
education_organizations_org_registry.lea: Zonke izinhlangano ezibhalisiwe lapho uhlala khona — amaphathi, amabhizinisi, izinhlangano ezingezomnotho nezinkampani zomphakathi, ohlisteni olulodwa oluvulekile.
education_organizations_org_registry.s1_: Irejista eyodwa, imodeli eyodwa, ihlukile kuphela ngokohlobo. Alikho isigaba seqembu.
education_organizations_org_registry.s2_: Noma ubani ohlala lapha angakwenza lokhu.
education_organizations_org_registry.s3_: Ukusekela, hhayi ubulungu, yikona okulinganiswa ngokuxhumana kwezombusazwe.
education_organizations_transfers_conver: Ukushintsha ukuthi ubani onikezwa inhlangano, noma ukushintsha uhlobo lwayo.
Ukuguqula kushintsha imithetho esebenza — kuhlanganise, ku-CGC, isimo sokuba yindawo yomphakathi phakade zalokho esivele sekwakhiwe.
education_rooms_directory.learn: Thola amakamelo omphakathi, imihlangano yekomiti, nezikhathi zokulalela ngokwendawo. Ukungena ekamelweni kulandela isikhungo nomhlangano owuvulayo; ukubheka uhlu akukufaki ocisheni.
education_rooms_directory.s1_detail: Sebenzisa ukuzula kwendawo ukuze uhlole uhlu lwendawo yegunya, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezikude nendawo okuyo njengamanje. Uhlu kulandela indawo ekhethiwe.
education_rooms_directory.s2_detail: Bheka amakamelo, amakomiti, noma izikhathi zenkantolo. Vula ikamelo elilistwe ukuze ubone isigaba sayo nomongo womhlangano; imingaanu yakomiti isebenzisa isixhumanisi somhlangano esikhona.
education_rooms_directory.s3_detail: Amakamelo ebhodi avele emabhodini lapho uneso isihlalo njengamanje. Imithetho yawo yokulunga kwamalungu isasebenza lapho ungena.
education_rooms_directory.s4_detail: Vula Imilayezo namaqembu ezinkulumo ezimfihlo. Ukuhlanganisa umsindo noma ividiyo yekamelo kuyisenzo esihlukile ekufundeni ikhasi lalo lomphakathi.
education_shared_accessibility.learn: Ukumela wonke lowo wakithi kusho interface wonke umuntu angayisebenzisa — kungukuthi kukhona amandla ahlukene, ulimi, indlela yokubhala, idivayisi, nokuxhumana. Lesi sithombe siqopha lokho okwakhiwe, lokho okungaqedwanga ngokwethembeka, nokuthi kuphi lapho kubikwa khona umehluko.
education_shared_accessibility.s1_detail: Ikhibhodi yakho yonke into, ukugxila okubonakalayo yonke indawo, ukuhlukana kwebala (AA contrast), ukulungiselela izikrini ezincane nokuzoom-a ngo-400%, ukusekelwa kokunqephelisa ukunyakaza, nokukhophi yesibuko kusukela kwesokunene kuya kwesokunxele. Uma isikrini singafinyeleli kulolu hlu, lokho kuyiphutha — hhayi ukukhetha.
education_shared_accessibility.s2_detail: Lokho okungakaqedi kulistwe kunokuba kufihliwe — ukuze wazi umehluko phakathi kwesikhala esihleliwe nesikhala okungukuthi akekho owaphawula ngaso.
education_shared_accessibility.s3_detail: Ukufikeleleka kuyisodwa sezihloko eziyisithupha zombiko, futhi umbiko uzithumelela kubantu abalungisa amaphutha okuklama. Awudingi isimo, indima, noma isimo se-akhawunti ukuze ufake owona.
education_shared_accessibility.why: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa akudingi lutho ngaphandle kokuhlala endaweni ovotela kuyo. I-interface umuntu angeke ayisebenzise ingengeza ngokuthulela isidingo umthethosisekelo owuvimbayo — yingakho iphutha lokufikeleleka lapha kuyiphutha lomthethosisekelo, hhayi ukuhlobisa. | Art. I
education_shared_atlas.learn: I-Atlas iyinhliziyo yomphakathi yomdlalo wonke — imephu eyodwa ephefumulayo kanye nezimpawu zokuphila zokumela, ubulungiswa, umnotho, namaseva athwele konke lokhu. Konke okukuyo kuhlanganyiswe; ayisoze yibonise umuntu ongakhethanga ukuvela.
education_shared_atlas.s1_detail: Amakhonodi, izindawo, izinhlangano, nabahlali abakhethile ukuvela — ezingeni ledolobha, izikhundla ezisungulwe, nezinga ongazicisha. Lokhu kuwukuzazi ukuthi ukuphi, hhayi ukulandelwa.
education_shared_atlas.s2_detail: Ukuvela kuyikho konke okukhethwa ngumuntu: ichashazi elilodwa elisungulwe, elibambelele ekugridini, elifakazelwe ngaphandle kwegama, elingasuswa. Izimpawu zakho zokuhlala ziyinto ehlukile ngokuphelele — zimfihlo, azishayelwa phambili, futhi azikho kule mephu.
education_shared_atlas.s3_detail: Izihlalo ezigcwele nezivulekile, ukukhetho nabakhethwa, amacala amajuri, iziphondo nomvolyume womakethe — yonke inombolo ivela emshinini, ihlanganyiswe. Ukufika kuwukulinganisa kokubambezeleka okubonakala kuphela: akukona ukungena ekubuseni, futhi akusona isikolo somuntu ngamunye.
education_shared_atlas.s4_detail: Izihlalo ezivulekile nokukhetho okuvulekile kulista lokho okudinga abantu njengamanje. Noma ubani ohlala lapha angama — i-Atlas ikukhombisa umnyango futhi ayifaki isithiyo phambi kwaso.
education_shared_atlas.why: Imephu idweba umugqa wonke uhlelo olugcinayo: ukubamba iqhaza kuyagujwa ngokuhlanganyiswa, kodwa akukho muntu owake ahlelwe, anikezwe amaphuzu, noma atholwe lapho ekhona. Indawo yegunya ingaba nohlu lwabaphambili; umuntu akasoze abe nalo.
education_shared_constitutional_question: Ukwakha umthethosisekelo kuhlelo lwe-software olusebenzayo kuphoqa izinqumo umbhalo ongazenza — futhi le leda igcina zonke zona irekhodi: umbuzo, impendulo ekhethiwe ukwakha, nokuthi kuphi lapho ubukela khona leyo pendulo isebenza.

Yinye ngayinye ibiza umbhalo womthethosisekelo ewuthinta, lokho okutholwe ekuzameni ukukwakha, nempendulo esebenzisayo ogwalweni olulodwa — nezixhumanisi zezikrini lapho impendulo ibonakala khona, ukuze ukwazi ukuyigweba isebenza.
Yonke imaki enjalo kulo lonke uhlelo iholela ekugcinweni kwayo lapha. Ukukhetha ukuhumusha akuthulela — ungahlale ulandelela ukuziphatha ubuyisele embuzweni okukhiqize khona.

Izingeniso zengezwa lapho kuvela imibuzo emisha; ezikhona zandiswa kuphela, azibhalwa kabusha. Ukushintsha uhlelo olusebenzayo kudlula ezinyangeni zezilungiso — le khasi liyisiphawulo sokuthembeka eceleni kwazo, futhi lisebenzisa udraft olandelayo womthethosisekelo.

Isofthiwe esisebenzisa umthethosisekelo sinamandla okuhumusha, futhi impendulo eqotho wukubhala zonke izindlela ezisetshenziswa ngazo obala. Irekhodi yilo lokuvuma — lungaguquki, lengeza kuphela, futhi elibhalelwe abantu abazobuyikela umbhalo.
education_shared_coverage.learn: Ukugubuzela kukhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izigaba zohlelo lokusebenza ezakhiwe, ezakhiwe ngokwashu, nezisahluhliwe. Iyimephu eqotho yesofthiwe uqobo.
education_shared_coverage.s1_detail: Okugreens kusebenza futhi kufinyeleleka. Okunye konke kuhleliwe: ikhasi noma ikhono alisakhona, futhi uhlelo lokusebenza lutsho lokho esikhundleni sokuzenza.
education_shared_coverage.s2_detail: Wonke umugqa ubiza indlela ne-surface engemuva kwayo, ukuze uqonde lapho okusebenzayo.
education_shared_coverage.s3_detail: Uma okugreens kungasebenzi kuwe, Bika inkinga kunoma yisiphi isigaba se-Learn, kuyifayila ne-surface id ihambisana nayo.
education_shared_coverage.why: umthetho womsebenzi ukuthi ukuhamba kokuqala akufiki kulokhu okubhalwe njengesikhala. Ukugubuzela yindlela lokho okuthembiswe khona okuhlolwa obala.
education_shared_coverage_ops.learn: I-matrix yokugubuzela iyisizinda sokukhipha: wonke umugqa we-registry, isimo sokuhamba, ne-surface kumele kuholele ekhasini langempela ngaphambi kokuba kube khona okuhambiswa.
education_shared_coverage_ops.s1_detail: Imigqa yizincazelo ze-registry; amakolamu yizinhlololo (indlela ikhona, ikhasi livela, i-surface ibhaliswe, umbhalo wokufunda ukhona).
education_shared_coverage_ops.s2_detail: Isigaba esibomvu isithembiso esaphulwe endaweni ethile ku-registry. Umugqa ukutshela ukuthi iyiphi idayilu okumele ilungiswe.
education_shared_coverage_ops.s3_detail: Kuba lugreens konke kusho ukuthi "kuqedile" ekukhipheni; i-matrix engakugreens ngokuphelele ithunyelwa njengegapho olaziwayo, hhayi njengento eqedile.
education_shared_coverage_ops.why: ukuqotho kohlelo lokusebenza kuhlolwa ngendlela efanayo nohulumende walo — ngokusebenzisa irekhodi noma ubani angayifunda.
education_shared_launchpad.learn: Umnyango ongaphambili womhlaba wonke — izindlela ezine zokungena, izinhlobo ezisishiyagalolunye zezindawo eziphilayo, nomhlahlandlela wezinhambo ezifundisa ngokwenza. Alukho lutho kulomyango oluhlola ukuthi ungubani; yonke indlela kuleli khasi ivulelekile kunoma ubani ohambayo.
education_shared_launchpad.s1_detail: Iminyango emine yizindawo zokufika zangempela: isimemo somngane, okwenzekayo namuhla lapho uhlala khona, i-Atlas ephilayo, noma uqonde ngqo egumbini eliphilayo. Akunye kuzo okucela i-akhawunti kuqala.
education_shared_launchpad.s2_detail: Izinhlobo ezisishiyagalolunye zomhlangano zihlanganyela emnyango owodwa owaziwayo — ikomiti, igumbi lomhlangano, itafula likesigungu esiphethe, inkantolo, ibhodi, iforum, ihholo lomphakathi, indandatho yabangani. Izinhlangano zomphakathi zivulekile njalo ukuze kubukwe; iqulu elingaphakathi linquma ukubonakala kwalo.
education_shared_launchpad.s3_detail: Uhambo ngalunye lukuhambisa entweni eyodwa yangempela lo mhlaba owenzayo — okwenzekayo manje, iyini ingxenye yakho, kwenzekani ngokulandelayo — udlula emigumbini yangempela endleleni. Qedela olulodwa bese uthola impumelelo ongayikhombisa ku-profile yakho; ayikuniki okunye — akukho kuvota, akukho isihlalo, akukho khono.
education_shared_launchpad.s4_detail: Ngaphansi, zonke izinhambo zingenye yezinhlobo ezinhlanu zokuxhumana. Leyo mephu isetshenziswa kamuva, lapho usuvele ube lapha isikhathi esithile — ayisoze yaba yisidingo sanoma yini.
education_shared_tour.learn: Uhambo luwuhlobo lokusebenza, hhayi indawo — indlela eyodwa eqondile kuyo yonke isikrini, nebhala le-Back / Next phezulu kwento yangempela. Ngena noma kuphi, phuma noma nini; ukuhamba kulokhu akushintshi lutho ngamalungelo akho noma isimo sakho.
education_shared_tour.s1_detail: Indlela emfushane ilandela indlela yokufika yangempela: isimemo somngane, igumbi eliphilayo, ikhaya, umhlaba ophilayo, iphepha lokuvota lakho lokuqala. Imizuzu eyishumiC.
education_shared_tour.s2_detail: Isimo ngasinye siyisikrini sangempela, sisetshenziswa ngokuphelele — hhayi ikhophi yezithombe. Uhambo nje lwengeza u-Back / Next phezulu, ukuze ukwazi ukuzulazula ngaphakathi esimweni bese usathola indlela yakho.
education_shared_tour.s3_detail: Sebenzisa imenyu ejwayelekile noma nini bese uhambo luzosusa nje; buyela kuleli index ukuze uthole uhlu oluphelele. Ukuqedela uhambo akukuniki lutho — akukho indima, akukho kuvota, akukho khono — futhi ukulishiya akubizi lutho.
education_social_achievements.learn: Irekhodi lakho elitholakele — izinto zokuqala zomphakathi nezinhambo eziqedile — ligcinwe njengohlu, hhayi njengesikolo. Alukho lutho kuleli khasi olunika okuthile: akukho kuvota, akukho isihlalo, akukho indima, akukho kufanele, naphakade.
education_social_achievements.s1_detail: Izimpumelelo ezivumelele zibhalwa uhlelo lapho irekhodi elingaguquki likhombisa isenzo — ukufayila, ukuhlala esihlalweni, ukuqinisekisa. Izimpumelelo mayelana nokuvota zifunda kuphela isingubo esivalekile esifakazela ukuthi uhambe; iphepha lokuvota ngaphakathi alivulwa neze.
education_social_achievements.s2_detail: Izincazelo ezivumelele zifakazelwa yirekhodi lohlelo lokusebenza. Izincazelo zokuhamba zivela ezinhambweni eziqondisiwe futhi ziyizinhlololo ezibikwe ngomuntu uqobo — zibizwa ngokuthi zizokuhamba ukuze zingakwazi ukuboleka ukwethenjwa kwezinga elivumelele.
education_social_achievements.s3_detail: Izimpumelelo zakho ziyimfihlo kuze kube yilapho ukhetha ukuzikhombisa, futhi amamitha akho okuhamba abalwa ngokusebenza kwakho lapho ubuka — awagcinwa njengesikolo esigcinwe. Nokuba zikhonyiswe noma zifihliwe, akukho okushintshayo.
education_social_achievements.s4_detail: Ukuqedela ukuqeqeshwa kunika ibhonasi yomholo kanye kuphela. Lokhu "kanye" kulawulwa lapha: leli rekhodi lingengeza imininingwane kuphela, ngakho impumelelo itholakala kanye — futhi ibhonasi eyifunda ayikwazi ukukhokha kabili.
education_social_achievements.s4_do: Thatha ibhonasi yokuqedela kanye lapho kufanele
education_social_achievements.why: Inkonzo ebhala leli khasi ayibali. Ibuyisa izimpumelelo ozibambile, hhayi ukuthi zingaki — iphesenti yokuqedela isikolo somuntu ngamunye esigqoke isigqoko esihlukile. Izindawo zegunya zingagubha izinsukwana ndawonye; abantu abalokhu abaqhathaniswa. Futhi akukho isango lapho sibheka lolu hlu: ukuphakama embizweni kudinga ukuhlala, futhi akukho okunye.
education_social_legitimacy.learn: Ukufika kuwukulinganisa kokuthi bangaki abantu bendawo abaqinisile ukuhlala kwabo futhi bathathe ingxenye. Kukutshela ukuthi uhulumeni wendawo yegunya umele kangakanani namuhla; akuthathi sinqumo.
education_social_legitimacy.s1_detail: Abahlali abaqinisekiswe ohambisana nabantu ababalwe. Inombolo ephansi isho ukuthi abantu abambalwa abasebevele bafike, hhayi ukuthi uhulumeni awusebenzi.
education_social_legitimacy.s2_detail: Indawo yonke ifundwa ngendlela efanayo, kuzo zonke iziziba, ngakho umuzi nomuzinda kungaqhathaniswa ngokushesha.
education_social_legitimacy.s3_detail: Alikho. Ukufika akuvimbi ukukhetho, isihlalo, noma ilungelo; isidingo esikodwa kuphela yonke indawo ukuhlala.
education_social_legitimacy.why: ukwethenjwa kukhula njengoba abantu befika. Isilinganiso sithembekile ngokuthi indawo imi kuphi ukuze kungabikho muntu okumele athembise isitatimende.
education_social_profile.learn: Wonke umuntu — wena, umakhelwane, umkhethwa, ophethe isihlalo sakho — ubonakala kuleli phrofayili elifanayo elinethebhu. Ukuthi yiziphi izithebhu ezivulekile emphakathini kunqumwa umthethosisekelo, hhayi ngezikhundla: ayikho inhlobo yephrofayili ehlukile yabasebenzi bombuso.
education_social_profile.s1_detail: Isibizo sokusebenza (handle) siyisisekelo; ukukhombisa igama lakho lomthetho kuyisinqumo osithathayo, futhi noma ngabe ukhetha yikuphi, unamalungelo afanayo. Igama elingelona elangempela yindlela ephelele yokuphila impilo yezomphakathi.
education_social_profile.s2_detail: Ithebhu yeRekhodi yimlando yezomphakathi ocwaningwe: ukuhlala, ukubamba iqhaza, izikhundla, izifayela. Ikhombisa ukuthi umuntu uvote, hhayi ukuthi uvote kanjani — futhi ingengezwa kuphela, ayikwazi ukuhlelwa ngasese.
education_social_profile.s3_detail: Umuntu ozifake ekhethweni uthola ithebhu yoMkhethwa; umuntu ophethe isihlalo uthola ithebhu seSikhundla. Lezo zithebhu zivulekile emphakathini ngoba ukufuna nokubamba amandla omphakathi kuvulekile — okunye empilweni yabo akukho emphakathini.
education_social_profile.s3_do: Bona ukukhethwa nezikhundla njengezithebhu, hhayi njengezobunjalo
education_social_profile.s4_detail: Ukulandela othile, ukuthumela umlayezo, noma ukuxhumana nomeleli akubizi lutho futhi akudingi ukujoyina lutho. Izimvume ozibona lapha zivulekile emphakathini kuphela ngoba wonke umuntu ovumile ukhethe ukukusho.
education_social_profile.why: Umgqikiza phakathi kokuvulekile nomfihlo kuleli khasi udweba umthethosisekelo, hhayi ukubaluleka komuntu. Izitatimende zomkhethwa zivulekile emphakathini futhi konke ukuhlelwa kubhalwa erekhodini; amarekhodi ezikhundla nanoma isiphi isinqumo esithathwe esikhundleni zivulekile futhi azikwazi ukuhlelwa; amaqembu, iwallet, nalabo obalandelayo bahlala imfihlo. Futhi iziqila ezivulekile zinikeza ulwazi — isivumelwano, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, asivimbi lutho.
education_support_report.learn: Uma kukhona okungashayi kahle — ikhasi elonakele, ukuhunyushwa okungashayi kahle, isithiyo sokufikeleleka, ukuhlukunyezwa — lena yiyo nyango eyodwa. Ukhetha isihloko; Umbiko uthola abantu abafanele ngokwakhe.
education_support_report.s1_detail: Kukhona okonakele, amagama noma ukuhunyushwa, isithiyo sokufikeleleka, ulwazi olungashayi kahle, ukuhlukunyezwa noma okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni, noma umbono. Ikhalazo ngokuziphatha komuntu lifayilwa ngaphansi kokuhlukunyezwa. Ukukhetha kwakho kuyindlela yokuhambisa — amaphutha nezithiyo ziya kubaqophi, amagama aya kubahumushi, imibono iya ohlu lwezinto okumele zenziwe.
education_support_report.s2_detail: Lokhu obukulindele, nalokhu obukubonile esikhundleni salokho. Ikhasi obukulo nephiyisheni yesoftware zizihlanganisa zodwa — awusoze udinge ukuchaza ukuthi ubukuphi. Ufayila kusuka ku-akhawunti yakho, kodwa awudingi ukusebenzisa igama lakho langempela, futhi lapho uhlala khona alisoze lihlanganiswe.
education_support_report.s3_detail: Umbiko uba ithikithi enenombolo ongakulandela kusukela ekubeni ngezinto ezintsha kuya kokuxazululeka emgqeni wezithikithi.
education_support_report.s4_detail: Umbiko wokuhlukunyezwa noma okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni ugwemela umgqeni wokusekela kwezobuchwepheshe uye ngqo eqandeni lokulawula neliqembu lomthetho — futhi ngisho nabo abahluleli bamibono. Okuqukethwe kususwa kuphela ngezinzila zokususa ezirekhodiwe — isinqumo senkantolo, ukuvikela amalungelo omunye, ukuvimba kwakho, noma ukuvimba i-spam okungathinti okuqukethwe. Abasebenzi bokusekela abasoze banqume ukuthi abantu bangasho ukuthini.
education_support_report.why: Qaphela isihloko esingekho ohlwuhlwu: ukukhala ngokunqotshwa kwesinqumo. Ukubalela isinqumo noma isenzo sesemthethweni kuyibhizinisi lomthethosisekelo — kufanele kube phambi kwezinkantolo (Art. IV), hhayi edeskini lokusiza. Ukusekela kulungisa isoftware; akunalo amandla phezu kwalokho noma ubani akwenzile ngayo.
education_support_ticket.learn: Umbiko owodwa kusukela ekufayileni kuya ekuxazululekeni: okushiwo, lapho kuhambiswe khona, nokushintsha kwesimo sonke — intambo ephilayo ongayengeza kuyo.
education_support_ticket.s1_detail: Inombolo, isimo, ukubaluleka, nesigaba, kanye nokuthi ubani obikile, lapho kuhambiswe khona, nekhasi lapho kwenzeke khona. Uma umbiko ungekho emsebenzini wokusekela kwezobuchwepheshe, ithikithi isho lokho ngokucacile — ukuhlukunyezwa kuhlala neqembu lokulawula nelomthetho, futhi inkinga yokuhunyushwa ihlala emgqeni wokubuyekezwa kololo ulimi, lapho abafundi bololo ulimi baqinisekisa isixazululo.
education_support_ticket.s2_detail: Isigameko ngasinye sithwele ukuthi ubani owenze isenzo, nini, nokuthi yini eshintshile — entsha, ihlungiswe, isesebenzwa, ixazululekile. Ukuhambisa kwenzeka erekhodini, hhayi ngemuva kwedeski.
education_support_ticket.s3_detail: Impendulo enemininingwane eyengeziwe noma indlela yokubuyisela inkinga ingaba yisici phakathi kokuthi "ayikwazi ukubuyiselwa" nokulungiswa.
education_support_ticket.s4_detail: I-+1 yakho itshela abantu abahlungisa ukuthi inkinga isabalale kangakanani. Kuyisignali yokufika, hhayi ukuvota — akukho okuncumwa lapha ngokudumisa.
education_support_tickets.learn: Yonke imibiko efayilwe nokuthi imi kuphi — akukho okunyamalala ebhokisini lemilayezo elingumfihlo. Ihlunga, landela eyakho, futhi nikeza isisindo ezinhlephweni ezikuthinta nawe.
education_support_tickets.s1_detail: "Open" ihlanganisa ezintsha, ezihlungiwe, neziqhubekayo; ezixazululiwe, ezivaliwe, nezingeke zilungiswe yizimo eziphelele. Isihloko sinciphisa uhlu kube yiziphambeko, ukubhalwa, ukufikeleleka, imininingwane engalungile, ukuhlukumeza, noma imibono.
education_support_tickets.s2_detail: Inombolo, ichashazi lobunzima, isihloko, isimo sayo, ikategori eyidluliselwe kuyo, ukuthi bangaki abantu abathi kuyibathinta, nokuthi isishintshile nini okusekugcineni.
education_support_tickets.s3_detail: Wonke umugqa uvula umbiko ogcwele nomlando wawo. Inkinobho yombiko ihlala iseduze noma yini oyitholayo engakabi emuhlalweni.
education_system_amendments.learn: Umthethosisekelo ushintsha ngeminyango emibili kuphela: izilungiselelo zishintshwa izinqumo ezijwayelekile phakathi kwezimingizelo ezishiwo, kanti ingqikithi eqinile ishintsha kuphela ngokukhishwa kwe-software edlula ukuhlola komthethosisekelo komphakathi.
education_system_amendments.s2_detail: Indlela yokubala, ifomula yeningi elikhethekile, amasango amalungelo. Akukho ningi lapho lungakushintsha lokhu ngesinqumo.
education_system_amendments.s3_detail: Noma yini engasiye eyala mibili ayisiyo indlela.
education_system_atlas.learn: I-Atlas iyinhliziyo ephilayo, yomphakathi yomdlalo wonke: wonke unode, yonke indawo evukile, nezibalo ezisebenza. Ikhombisa izwe; ayithinti amalungelo ayiphiyo muntu.
education_system_atlas.s1_detail: Izindawo ezisungulwe, izishayamthetho ezihlala ezihlalo, ukhetho okuqhubekayo — wonke umfigu ubalwa irekhodi, hhayi ukuthi ubhalwe ngumuntu.
education_system_atlas.s2_detail: Ukuvela emephu kuyinketho futhi akuphelele. Ichashazi likhetho lendawo yokubonakala, hhayi indawo yomuntu.
education_system_atlas.s3_detail: Lokhu kukhombisa kuphela. Akukho okusebenza lapha: akukho mngcele ku-Atlas ovula noma uvimba ivoti, ukuphikisa, noma isihlalo.
education_system_atlas.why: Umthethosisekelo wenza irekhodi libe lomphakathi kanti umuntu ube yimfihlo. I-Atlas yingxenye yomphakathi evelele njengesithombe.
education_system_audit_chain.learn: Ikhala lokucwaninga — wonke isinqumo somthethosisekelo, exhunywe ngohash ngokulandelana. Noma ubani angaqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okushintshwe ngasese.
education_system_audit_chain.s1_detail: Yonke imibiko efayilwe — eyamukelwe neyalelewe — iyingxenye, ngokulandelana.
education_system_audit_chain.s2_detail: Yonke ingxenye inohash lwengxenye engaphambi kwayo. Ukushintsha noma yiphi ingxenye yasendulo kuphula zonke izingxenye ezilandela yona.
education_system_audit_chain.s3_detail: Okuqukethwe amaphepha lokuvota akaze kuxhunywe. Ukubamba iqhaza kurekhodiwe; ukuthi uvote kanjani akurekhodiwe.
education_system_audit_chain.why: Ubufakazi bokungeneleli, hhayi ukuvimba ukungeneleli. Akekho othi okwedlule akukwazi ukushintshwa — isiqiniseko ukuthi ukukushintsha akukwazi ukufihliwa.
education_system_clocks.learn: Ukuhlanza okuhleliwe okuqhuba izwe — yonke imizuzu, usuku lokugcina, isikhathi, nomngcele oqala inqubo ngaphandle kokuba kube nomuntu ocela.
education_system_clocks.s1_detail: Izikhathi ezingu-21, zonke zinomjikelezo obalulwe nomphumela obalulwe.
education_system_clocks.s2_detail: Isikhathi samandla esimo esiphuthumayo asikwazi ukweluliswa ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezingamashumi amabili nesishiyagalolunye ngasinye isinqumo.
education_system_clocks.s3_detail: Usuku lokugcina oluncike ekutheni othile akhumbule akusona usuku lokugcina.
education_system_public_records.learn: Irekhodi lomphakathi elingaguquki — ubufakazi, amavoti, izinqumo, nezisulu, elifundeka kunoma ubani, elingaguqulwa muntu.
education_system_public_records.s2_detai: Amaphepha okuvota, izinkamisa, izindawo zokutholakala, kanye ne-social graph eyimfihlo kuvimbelwe ukushicilelwa — kunqanyulwa lapho konke kushicilelwa khona.
education_system_term_sync.learn: Kungani izikhathi zokuqashwa kwezombuso nobulungiswa zihamba ndawonye, nokuthi kungani lokho kubalulekile.
education_system_term_sync.s1_detail: Zombili zingaminyaka eyishumi, futhi kumele zihlale zihambisana.
education_system_translation_review.lear: Ulimi olulodwa, ikhasi elilodwa: ukuthi ingxenye engakanani yezwe ifunda ngalo, okubhalwe umshini, nokuthi abafundi balo baqinisekiseni. Umsebenzi womshini nowomuntu awudidwa neze — udraft uhlala ubhalwe njengodraft kuze kube yilapho abantu abafunda ulimi kuvuma ukuthi uqondile.
education_system_translation_review.s1_d: Umbhalo we-interface, ukukopisha kwekhasi, umsindo womhlahlandlela, imibhalo — yinye yayo ibonisa i-progress bar yayo kanye nenani labaqinisekisi lalolu limi, ukuze ubeke imizamo yakho lapho kunenkinga kakhulu.
education_system_translation_review.s2_d: Yinye yazo ibonisa umthombo wesiNgisi eceleni kodraft yokuqala yomshini, okubi kakhulu kuqala — kuhlanganise nemibhalo umshini ngokwakhe ayenqabe ukuyithumela. Amukela udraft omuhle noma uphakamise amazwi angcono.
education_system_translation_review.s3_d: Umbhalo uba ngoweqinisekisiwe ngumphakathi kuphela lapho abafundi abanele bolimi bavuma. Ukuqinisekisa kuvimbelwe kubantu abafunda ulimi ngempela — hhayi ithimba elilodwa eliphakathi, futhi hhayi umshini ozizibeka amamaki.
education_system_translation_review.s4_d: Amakhodi efomu, iqhaza, iwashi, kanye ne-workflow (F-…, R-…, CLK-…, WF-…) awuhunyushwa neze. Ahlala efana kuwo wonke ulimi, ukuze ukucashunwa kusho into efanayo yonke indawo emhlabeni.
education_system_translations.learn: Izilimi i-app ebizayo, nokuthi ziphelele kangakanani.
education_system_translations.s1_detail: Ukuhunyushwa komshini nokwomuntu kubekwe ngendlela ehlukile, ukuze wazi ukuthi ufunda ukuthini.
education_system_translations.s2_detail: Izibonisi zefomu, iqhaza, newashi zahlala zifana kuwo wonke ulimi, ukuze ukucashunwa kusho into efanayo yonke indawo.
